title: Senior Content Director
description:
**About Onnit:**

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. As a trusted and serious supplement brand, we provide high-quality products with clinically studied ingredients designed to unlock a deeper mind-body connection and enhance both mental and physical performance. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

We are part of the Wellbeing Collective, an exciting Global Business Unit within Unilever built with a start-up mindset. Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

**Why this role, why now**

Onnit is reinvigorating our content strategy and how people will see it. We're looking for a Senior Content Director to make Onnit the most watched, most shared, most recognizable brand in performance and wellness, without a Hollywood budget.

Onnit was built on a simple idea: train the total human, body and mind. That idea earned us a loyal community of athletes, fighters, lifters and everyday high performers, and a product line people swear by, from Alpha BRAIN to our kettlebells and steel maces.

As part of Unilever's Wellbeing Collective, we have the backing to go big. We're choosing to move like a startup.

We're writing Onnit's next chapter, and we want a content leader who sees that as the opportunity of a career. You'll define how Onnit looks, sounds and shows up everywhere: on a TikTok, a product page, a YouTube series, the side of a tub.

**The role**

The Senior Content Director owns Onnit's content strategy and output across every channel, and builds the in-house engine that produces it. This is a leadership role reporting to the CMO.

You'll set the creative direction, build a lean, high-velocity content operation, and turn our athletes, partners and customers into the stories that drive the brand.

You're equal parts strategist, storyteller and operator: someone who can write the brief in the morning, shoot it on a phone at lunch, and read the retention curve by dinner.

* Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

* Scope: Social, YouTube, Onnit.com, email/CRM creative, Amazon and retail content, packaging, and new formats (podcast, series)

* Team: A small, scrappy in-house team plus a bench of freelancers, creators and partners you'll shape and grow

* Location: Remote, with a preference for Los Angeles, New York or Austin

**What You'll Own**

**1. Content strategy across every channel**

* Build and run one content strategy that spans social (TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook), YouTube, Onnit.com, email/SMS, Amazon, retail and packaging.

* Decide what each channel is for, what we post, how often, and how pieces flow from one platform to the next.

* Turn brand and business priorities (launches, seasonal moments, retail resets, promotions) into a content calendar that ships on time.

* Own the content metrics: reach, engagement, watch time, follower growth, and the content's contribution to traffic and conversion.

**2. An ownable Onnit look and feel**

* Define the visual and verbal identity of Onnit content so a post is recognizably ours within the first second, with or without a logo.

* Create the playbook: tone of voice, formats, editing style, typography, color, sound, and the do's and don'ts that keep everyone on-brand.

* Make sure the same brand shows up on a 7-second Reel, a YouTube episode, a PDP and a package on shelf.

**3. A lean, in-house content engine**

* Build a content operation that produces a high volume of quality work without a big team, a studio or expensive equipment.

* Favor speed and iteration over polish: phone-first shoots, rapid edits, reusable templates, and one idea cut into many pieces.

* Set up the workflows, tools (including AI-assisted editing and production) and freelancer bench that let a small team punch far above its weight.

* Ship in days, not months. No months of storyboarding, no five-figure photo shoots for a single post.

**4. Algorithm-obsessed distribution**

* Know how each platform's algorithm rewards content right now, and adjust as it changes.

* Engineer for performance: hooks, retention, pacing, captions, thumbnails, posting cadence, trends and sounds.

* Own a real-time feedback loop: daily performance reads, a weekly content review, and a living scorecard by platform, format and talent. Double down on winners within days, kill what doesn't work, and feed every lesson straight back into the strategy.

* Use social listening and comment sections as a source of ideas, not just a metric.

**5. Athletes,** **talent** **and creators**

* Partner with Onnit athletes, ambassadors and personalities (from elite athletes and fighters to coaches, creators and everyday customers) to tell their stories in a way that feels real, not scripted.

* Help shape who we partner with, and get the most content value out of every relationship.

* Write clear, smart briefs for creators and influencers that protect the brand and leave room for the creator's voice.

* Work with the social and influencer lead to turn creator content into paid, organic and on-site assets.

**6. Community and fandom**

* Use content to turn customers into a community and a community into fans.

* Build recurring formats our audience shows up for: training series, challenges, education, behind-the-scenes, member and customer stories.

* Work with the community and events team so live moments become content, and content drives people to live moments.

**7. New formats: podcast, series and beyond**

* Develop and launch Onnit's own shows: a podcast, YouTube series, and other longform or episodic formats.

* Orchestrate the whole thing: concept, talent, production model, distribution and clipping strategy.

* Treat long-form as the engine that feeds short-form, and short-form as the funnel back to long-form.

**Who You'll Work With**

**Social & influencer lead:** Co-own the creator program, briefs, and the flow of creator content into owned and paid channels

**Community & events:** Turn events, challenges and member moments into content, and content into turnout

**Growth / performance marketing:** Supply and iterate creative for paid social and search; learn from what converts

**DTC (Onnit.com):** Bring the brand to life on the site: PDPs, landing pages, email and SMS creative

**Amazon:** Elevate listings, A+ content, brand store and video to lift conversion

**Retail:** Shelf-ready assets, packaging content and retailer marketing

**Product & innovation:** Tell the story behind new products from concept to launch

**CMO and leadership team:** Set direction, report on impact, and be a voice for the brand

**Qualifications**

Must-haves

* 12–15+ years in content, creative or brand storytelling, with at least 5 years leading content strategy and people for a consumer brand, media company or creator-led business.

* A portfolio that proves you can build an audience: channels you grew, formats you invented, content that moved real numbers.

* Deep, current fluency in platform algorithms across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, and the instinct to change course when they shift.

* A builder's track record: you've stood up a lean, in-house content function and made it produce at volume.

* Hands-on craft. You can write, direct, and give sharp edit notes, and you're not above picking up the phone and shooting it yourself.

* Experience working with athletes, talent or creators, including writing briefs and managing those relationships.

* Modern storytelling instincts: you know a great story has to earn attention in the first two seconds and still mean something at the end.

* A relentless analytical mindset. You live in the numbers daily, not monthly: you always know what's working, what isn't and why. You turn those reads into changes in real time, shifting formats, hooks, talent, cadence and spend within days, not quarters. To you, the content strategy is a living system that gets smarter every week.

* Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to rally many teams around one brand.

Big pluses

* Sports, fitness or an adjacent category (outdoor, combat sports, endurance, athleisure, gaming, wellness media).

* Supplements, beauty or wellness experience: a huge plus. You understand how to tell product stories credibly in a regulated category (claims, substantiation, FTC disclosures).

* You've launched or produced a podcast or YouTube series.

* Experience creating content for Amazon and retail, not just social.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30 days: You've audited every channel, shipped quick wins, raised posting cadence, and sent out the first new creator briefs.

* First 60 days: The content strategy and Onnit look-and-feel playbook are set. The inhouse engine ships daily across core platforms, and the performance scorecard and weekly review are running.

* First 90 days: Engagement, watch time and follower growth are measurably up. Athlete stories and creator content run on a steady rhythm, and the first recurring community series is live.

* First 6 months: Onnit content is instantly recognizable, the engine runs at high volume on a lean budget, and a podcast or YouTube series has launched.

**You'll** **Thrive Here If You**

* Would rather ship ten ideas this week than perfect one this quarter.

* Get energy from building something, not maintaining it.

* Check the comments before you check your email.

* Believe the best brands today behave like media companies.

* Want the freedom, and the accountability, that come with helping lead a brand's comeback.

**Benefits**

* Full medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Basic Life Insurance
* Immediate 401(k) eligibility with company matching
* Unlimited vacation
* Paid holidays
* Flexible workplace policy
* $100/month flexible benefit stipend
* Tuition reimbursement
* Fringe benefits include in-office meals, product credits and discounts, lifestyle spending account, family planning, online learning, fitness stipend, among many others

As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
  
  
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.

**What You’ll Do**

* Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
* Lead Idea-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest-stakes brand investments.
* Hands-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
* Build & Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
* Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
* Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.
* Push Product Integration: Find innovative ways to bring the product into the brand story, demonstrating the full creative potential of the platform.
* Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.

title: Engineering Director, EU
description:
***We're on a mission to make money work for everyone.***

We're waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We're not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or Remote (UK) or Barcelona, Spain (Hybrid)

### **Engineering at Monzo**

Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.

The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.

Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.

As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.

Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.

This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.

**What you'll work on**

* Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.
* Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.
* Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.
* Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.
* Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.
* Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.
* Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.
* Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.
* Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.
* Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.

### **You should apply if**

* You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.
* You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.
* You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.
* You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.
* You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.
* You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.
* You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.
* You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.
* You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.

### **The interview process**

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages:

* **Initial Call (1 hour)** You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They'll ask example based questions ('Tell me about a time when…')

* **Loop Stage** - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.

At all stages we'll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you're interviewing us as well!

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

  

**How we work :**

**Locations & Flexible Working (If you're in the UK) :**

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there's no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

**Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.**

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You'll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. ✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

### **What's in it for you**

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain

✅ We can sponsor visas for the UK (not Spain)

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 ( a year for books, training courses and conferences

#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE

**Equal opportunities for everyone**

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we're making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we're embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Wind Turbine Driveline Systems
description:
The successful candidate will be a part of GE Vernova’s Wind Global Machine Head Driveline subsystem. The team is responsible for mechanical hardware (main bearing, main shaft, covers, rotor locks, rotor brakes, and couplings) including New Product / Technology Introduction, Validation & Testing, Field Support, and Root Cause Analysis for utility scale wind turbines.
  
  
This position will primarily support the high speed rotor lock, rotor brake, and flex coupling through the entire life cycle from conceptual design through detailed design and development, testing, qualification, manufacturing, validation, and installed fleet support. The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

**Job Description**
===================

**The Opportunity**

Wind turbine reliability is engineered before a single blade turns — in the design of the rotor brakes, locks, and couplings that have to perform for decades in some of the most demanding environments on earth. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at GE Vernova, you will own the full design lifecycle for Machine Head Driveline subsystem components across the wind turbine fleet: from specification and analysis through validation testing, root cause investigation, and standardization across the global product portfolio.

This is a role for someone who combines deep mechanical design expertise with the judgement to make consequential decisions independently — and the collaborative instinct to bring manufacturing, sourcing, quality, and field teams along with them.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead component design and development** — design build-to-spec rotor brakes & couplings and build-to-print rotor locks for wind turbines; own component specification design, system interaction analysis, and reliability verification through physical testing; drive new product introduction and new technology integration from concept through to validated production release.

* **Own design quality and documentation standards** — ensure quality of new and revised drawings, BoMs (Bills of Materials), and specifications in accordance with GE Vernova and industry processes; own and drive lessons learned, design best practices, and standardization into design practices, drawings, and technical specifications.

* **Develop and execute validation plans** — design testing and validation programs to prove component function and reliability; resolve field issues through root cause analysis and identify design-based corrective actions that prevent recurrence.

* **Solve cross-functional manufacturing and field issues** — work closely with quality, manufacturing engineering, sourcing, suppliers, and field support teams to improve product quality and FTY (First-Time Yield); provide design-based corrective actions for NCR (Non-Conformance Report), SDR (Supplier Deviation Request), and PAC (Product Acceptance Criteria) issues.

* **Identify and execute cost and technology improvements** — identify and deliver cost-saving strategies; introduce advanced materials, manufacturing methods, and design tools to advance the strategic position of Driveline subsystem components within the broader wind turbine portfolio.
  

**About You**

You are a senior mechanical engineer with extensive experience in component design, analysis, and validation for rotating or power generation equipment — comfortable operating with a high degree of independence while driving outcomes across global, cross-functional teams. You are also experienced working with suppliers and manufacturing processes to ensure your design is consistently produced with high quality.

**Required**

* A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar discipline.

* Major experience in mechanical analysis and design in an industrial or product engineering environment.

* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing), and manufacturing processes.

* Proficiency in 3D CAD (Computer-Aided Design) tools — specifically Unigraphics / Siemens NX.

* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across different geographies and cultural contexts.

* Clear communication, project management, and interpersonal skills — with the ability to present complex technical findings to diverse audiences.

* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering.

* Experience in design and/or application of mechanical components in the powertrain of rotating equipment.

* Working knowledge of ANSYS or other FEA (Finite Element Analysis) tools.

* Experience in design or product development of mechanical components in wind turbines or other power generation products.

* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), and DFM (Design for Manufacturability) / DFI (Design for Installation) / DFS (Design for Serviceability) methodologies.

* Exposure to PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) processes and tools.

* Track record of collaborating with product managers and suppliers to optimize component costs and shape purchasing strategy.
  

**Why GE Vernova**

GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. In this role, you will contribute directly to the reliability and performance of wind energy technology that operates at scale across the global fleet — supported by a team that values engineering rigour, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

We provide varied, competitive benefits designed to reward high performers and support your personal and family needs. GE Vernova invests in your continued on-the-job learning and development and provides a clear path for career growth within a global organization.

  

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike's Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike's AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

**Role Scope:**

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike's agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

**MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:**

* Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
* Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
* Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
* Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

**Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:**

* Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
* Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
* Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
* Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

**What You Will Help Shape:**

* A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
* GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
* A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

### **Your Impact:**

* Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers' existing ecosystems.
* Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
* Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
* Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
* Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
* Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
* Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

**Why This Role Is Unique:**

* You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
* You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
* The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

### **What's Next?**

* Introduction Call with a Recruiter

* Conversation with the AI Product Director

* Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives

* Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

title: Performance Media Buyer

* Very detail-oriented with a meticulous approach and be able to manage multiple campaigns successfully
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Money conscious with an innovative approach and ability to thrive in a fast-paced working environment
* Proactive, a strong communicator and confident with pitching new opportunities to external clients
* Analytical mind, good with calculations and statistical interpretation
* Problem-solving attitude
* Interest in following advertising and media trends

* Experience with RevShare models.

You will be the day-to-day owner of one of Kyra's largest and most complex global enterprise accounts: a fast-moving, multi-category consumer brand with 12+ sub-brands, 35+ active stakeholders, and campaigns running simultaneously across multiple regions.

You’ll design a creative system for rapid, high-quality production across channels, repurposing standout moments from podcasts, events, and behind-the-scenes footage. **What You’ll Do**

title: Senior Tech Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
#### **About Qualifyze:**

Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,500 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.

#### **Role Overview:**

We’re looking for a **Senior Talent Acquisition Partner with strong experience in tech hiring** to join our People team and take ownership of Talent Acquisition across Qualifyze, partnering with stakeholders across our business. You’ll touch the full recruitment cycle and all areas.

**The challenge?** Going beyond filling roles. You’ll act as a trusted advisor to Hiring Managers, combining your recruitment expertise with data and market insights to shape hiring strategies in collaboration with the Head of People, challenge assumptions and attract the right talent.

You’ll also have the autonomy to improve how we hire, from optimizing processes and enhancing the candidate experience to exploring new sourcing approaches and strengthening our employer brand. We’re looking for someone proactive and hands-on who enjoys navigating change and balancing hiring delivery.

You’ll be part of a People team of seven, working closely with our Talent Acquisition Intern.

#### **Main responsibilities:**

* Own the end-to-end recruitment process across Tech & Data, Product, Growth, Finance and Quality, translating business needs into effective recruitment plans and sourcing strategies.
* Act as a trusted advisor and partner to Hiring Managers, providing guidance on talent availability, role requirements, compensation expectations and recruitment best practices, while managing expectations and ensuring alignment throughout the process.
* Use recruitment data and talent market insights to guide day-to-day decisions, build reports on key hiring metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve sourcing strategies and hiring outcomes.
* Optimise recruitment processes, workflows and tools, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability and collaboration through new approaches and technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.
* Ensure a high-quality candidate and Hiring Manager experience throughout the recruitment process, maintaining a consistent approach and a high bar for quality.
* Strengthen Qualifyze’s employer brand and position the company as an attractive place to work through targeted talent attraction initiatives.

#### **Main requirements:**

* **You know your way around Talent Acquisition:** 5+ years experience managing end-to-end hiring in a fast-paced environment, ideally in a scale-up or international company. Comfortable juggling several roles at once, prioritizing effectively and adapting when business needs change.
* **Tech hiring is your thing:** Hands-on experience hiring across technical teams, including Frontend and Backend Engineers, DevOps, Data Engineers, Data Scientists and BI profiles. No need to be an engineer, but confidence discussing technical requirements with Hiring Managers and understanding what makes a good fit is key.
* **A data-driven approach:** Comfortable working with recruitment metrics and building hiring reports, spotting bottlenecks and turning insights into better hiring decisions and outcomes.
* **You know how to challenge a hiring brief:** Able to build trust with Hiring Managers, ask the right questions and challenge assumptions when needed, keeping hiring strategies grounded in business priorities and what the talent market can realistically offer.
* **Always looking for better ways to hire:** With a continuous improvement mindset, you’re always looking for ways to make recruitment more effective, whether it’s refining a sourcing strategy, simplifying a workflow or exploring new tools and technologies, while improving the experience we offer candidates.
* **Ownership and business acumen:** Things move quickly at Qualifyze, so this role calls for someone who takes initiative, makes sound decisions independently and connects recruitment priorities to wider business goals. Strong business acumen and the ability to focus on what will make the biggest difference are essential.
* **You stay on top of your work:** Proactive and organized, with a good handle on priorities and follow-ups. Someone who takes accountability for their work, anticipates what needs attention and keeps others in the loop so people know they can count on you.

**Salary**

At Qualifyze, our salary ranges are transparent internally, and we aim to follow a similar approach externally. For this role, we’re happy to share a reference point within the band: the expected salary range is around **45,000€ - 50,000€**.

Final compensation will depend on experience and performance during the process, with some flexibility within the range.

#### **What do we offer?**

* Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package
* Country vacation package that increases with your tenure
‍* ️Country specific benefits offering incl. private health care, fitness and meal allowances
* Annual personal development budget to increase your impact
* Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.
* All the best kit and tools to work effectively
* Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe
* Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career

#### **Use of AI in Our Recruitment Process:**

We believe in a human-led hiring process. All applications are reviewed manually by our Talent Acquisition team, and neither Talent Acquisition nor Hiring Managers use AI to screen, filter, rank, assess, or make decisions about candidates, including during interviews and assessments. During interviews, AI may be used only to support note-taking and transcription.

All hiring decisions are made by people!

#### **Diversity & Inclusion at Qualifyze:**

At Qualifyze we actively support the power of diversity, uniting complementary talents and perspectives to address new challenges. Our collective strengths help us to find innovative solutions and turn difficulties into opportunities. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs and feels heard.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

Working at the intersection of Product, Technology, and our partner ecosystem, you'll take a capability with proven value and define how it scales. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact. You will report to the Global Head of Revenue Management and Pricing, and work as part of the Reshopping program led by the Program Leader, Reshopping.

  

**Location**

This role can be based in one of our major offices in in Barcelona or London. Fully remote in EU region may be considered for the right person.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and document the product strategy — the purpose, ambition and direction of the domain — and communicate it clearly across the business.
* Maintain an informed view of the post-booking cost optimization market, so that product decisions are innovative and genuinely differentiated.
* Facilitate ongoing research to understand consultant needs, customer expectations, competitive landscape, and emerging travel technology trends; share findings with stakeholders to inform strategy.
* Translate strategy into clear product roadmaps and prioritized requirements that enable the Tech team to design and size solutions and deliver. Prioritise effectively using an MVP-first mindset, balancing business impact, technical feasibility, product commitments, stakeholder feedback.
* Build trusted relationships with and gather input from stakeholders across customers and prospects, global business units, travel consultants, and executive leadership; synthesize diverse perspectives and keep all parties aligned and informed.
* Own and evolve the commercial model, so that the value created for customers is also value realized for the business.
* Shape global GTM and rollout sequencing, working closely with the delivery leader, working market by market so that each launch reflects local operational, industry, and customer requirements.
* Maintain a working view of the end-to-end process, human and automated, and identify opportunities to automate and AI enable.
* Evaluate where AI Enablement can improve outcomes while maintaining appropriate levels of auditability and deterministic logic.
* Establish and monitor quality and success metrics, including savings identified and realized, rebooking conversion, and savings methodology integrity. Define and track product KPIs to measure adoption, engagement, and delivered value; use insights to drive iteration cycles.
* Contribute to a safe, inclusive, accessible, and fun work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive.
  

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience owning a product and roadmap end-to-end, with measurable business outcomes.
* Proven at building commercial models for new offerings and evolving them as products mature.
* A track record of raising automation within a product, with the judgment to know which manual steps to remove and which are worth keeping because they add value for the customer.
* Skilled at agreeing data and process handoffs across teams.
* Able to communicate complex topics to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.
* Grounded in corporate travel or travel technology, including supplier commercial models, post-booking servicing, and managed travel program economics.
* Working knowledge of air content, fares, and ticketing data structures across GDS, NDC and other direct sources.
* Familiar with travel consultant workflows, operational needs, and common technology challenges.

title: Head of Global Events and Travel (100% REMOTE)
description:
The Head of Global Events & Travel leads the strategy, governance, and execution of our global events and corporate travel function. This role oversees three interconnected areas:

* **Flagship, VIP, High-Complexity & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events** (client and client’s customers events, executive dinners, and high-touch VIP gatherings);
* **Internal Meetings & Corporate Travel** (global gatherings, executive offsites, collaborators travel program); and
* **Dedicated Financial Control & Commercial Management**.

The Head is accountable for the full events and corporate travel portfolio, consolidated budgets, strategic supplier agreements, service standards, and duty-of-care governance. Serving both internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, prospects, and partners), the Head sets priorities, builds team capability, and manages major commercial decisions and C-level/client escalations. Financial oversight is supported by the Event & Travel Finance Lead in alignment with central Corporate FP&A.

A key initial priority is leading the implementation and transition to our enhanced travel operating model. Once established, the Head provides oversight through periodic performance reviews and exception management, delegating routine operations to the team and Travel Management Companies (TMCs).

**Responsibilities**

* **Function Leadership:** Lead and develop the Team. Recruit open roles, establish team cadence, and build capabilities across the function. Strategic resource planning across agencies, production vendors, and internal talent to execute both internal and client-facing events seamlessly.
* **Flagship, VIP & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events:** Execute on objectives, budgets, and brand standards set by C-Level leadership for 5,000-attendee conference, VIP executive receptions, and regional customer summits. Manage delivery through the internal Team, supported by event specialists and external agencies. Lead venue selection, production, security, contract negotiations, and attendee experience for both internal and external audiences.
* **Internal Meetings & Offsites:** Oversee the internal gathering strategy and delivery. Standardize playbooks for routine company meetings and regional leadership offsites.
* **Travel Operating Model Transition:** Lead the implementation of our approved global travel operating model, including RFPs and contracts for multi-region TMCs, unified policy and expense frameworks, approvals, reconciliation, and dual quoting. Coordinate phased migration corridor-by-corridor, validate vendor acceptance, protect service continuity, and establish an operational handover once stable.
* **Corporate Travel Oversight:** Own global travel strategy, master agreements, and major operational escalations. Oversee daily fulfillment, group flights, hotel blocks, rebooking, and high-touch support for executives, clients, and guest speakers managed by TMCs and the Travel & Logistics Coordinator.
* **Budget Accountability & Resource Stewardship:** Own the consolidated events and travel budget, as well as revenue/cost-recovery models for sponsored or client-facing events. Act as a steward of company resources, prioritizing expenditure against strategic business objectives, maximizing ROI on client events, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and escalating forecast overruns early with mitigation plans.
* **Financial Governance & Client Billing:** Work through the Team to manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, vendor deposits, event ledgers, cross-charging/client billing, invoice reconciliation, and post-event financial reviews. Maintain strict approval thresholds, separation of duties, purchase orders, payment terms, and international VAT/GST recovery.
* **Strategic Suppliers & Commercial Partnerships:** Lead major RFPs and negotiations with TMCs, airlines, hotel chains, event venues, registration platforms, and production partners. Maintain competitive discipline, set service expectations, and delegate routine vendor management while remaining the key point of contact for material escalations.
* **Policy, Duty of Care & Risk Management:** Own the global events and travel policy. Establish traveler assistance, emergency response, data privacy, and incident escalation frameworks in coordination with People Ops, Legal, IT, and Security, ensuring comprehensive coverage for collaborators, clients, and external VIP guests.
* **Cross-Functional & Client Partnership:** Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on client event revenue targets, sponsorships, client experience, and commercial outcomes. Collaborate with C-Level executives on internal event agendas, keynotes, and executive participation. Partner with Finance, Legal, and People Ops to streamline global delivery.
* **Events & Travel Leadership:** 8+ years leading corporate events and managed travel programs, including 3+ years leading a global function in a fast-growing, international environment.
* **Client & Internal Event Expertise:** Proven track record running both internal company meetings/offsites and high-impact, client- or customer-facing events (e.g., user conferences, client advisory boards, sponsored summits, roadshows).
* **Large-Scale Event Execution:** Proven experience directing large conferences (5,000+ attendees) end-to-end, covering budgets, venue sourcing, registration tech, production, speaker/VIP management, and vendor teams.
* **Travel Program Transformation:** Hands-on experience implementing or re-platforming corporate travel frameworks (TMC selections, booking/expense integrations, phased migrations, and duty-of-care rollouts). Multi-TMC or hybrid experience preferred.
* **Travel Industry & Commercial Fluency:** Strong understanding of airline/hotel distribution economics (GDS, NDC, dynamic pricing, corporate direct programs) and commercial contracting for high-value event venues and suppliers.
* **Financial & Commercial Acumen:** Demonstrated budget ownership, financial forecasting, ROI tracking, vendor negotiations, and client event billing/cost recovery. Experience with virtual-card systems or modern payment settlements is a plus.
* **Executive & External Presence:** Exceptional communication and presentation skills; comfortable engaging directly with C-Suite executives, enterprise clients, sponsors, and key industry partners.
* **Data Privacy & Duty of Care:** Solid understanding of global travel safety protocols, crisis management, GDPR compliance, vendor DPAs, and attendee data privacy standards.
* **Language & Mobility:** Professional fluency in English (Spanish and/or Italian are strong pluses). Willingness to travel internationally up to 40% and operate across European, Middle Eastern, and Americas time zones.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Head of People
description:
Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,600 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.

We are looking for a **Head of People** who will own the **operational infrastructure** that lets Qualifyze **hire, pay, develop, and retain people effectively**: Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Performance Management, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Administration, and Compliance. Reporting directly to the SVP of Finance, you are the backbone of the People function.

**You'll have end-to-end ownership.** Every area below is yours, from design through execution to results. You don't hand work off and step back. When something breaks, you fix it, then fix the process behind it

You'll **shape the team**, hire into new roles, and set the standards the People function runs on.

#### **Main responsibilities:**

* **Leading and developing a high-impact team:**
  + You'll lead a lean, pragmatic team across People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Business Partnering, setting clear priorities and performance expectations while carrying your own operational workload.
  + You'll coach each team member through regular 1:1s, reviews, and growth plans, building a team that becomes a trusted advisor to managers and business leaders as the business scales, hiring into open roles, and putting shared processes in place so delivery stays consistent across every location.
* **Driving end-to-end hiring & Employer Branding initiatives:**
  + You’ll deliver the hiring plan across all entities, owning the full recruitment process from sourcing and interviews to hiring manager enablement and offer management, while strengthening our employer brand to attract the talent we need.
  + You bring a data-driven mindset, tracking and acting on metrics such as time-to-hire, pipeline health, and source effectiveness to set priorities.
* **Building scalable People Operations & HR Systems:**
  + Own and continuously improve Personio and end-to-end People Operations across our entities ensuring accurate, compliant, and scalable processes throughout the employee journey.
  + Oversee accurate and timely payroll across all entities and jurisdictions, in collaboration with Accounting and external partners, while managing benefits administration and vendor relationships.
  + Drive operational excellence through automation, self-service, and AI-enabled solutions that improve the employee and manager experience, focusing on outcomes rather than activity.
  + Ensure compliance with local labour laws, maintain employment policies, contracts, and the employee handbook, and handle employee relations cases in partnership with legal counsel.
* **Driving our rewards policy & high-impact performance:**
  + Own compensation reviews, promotions, compensation ranges, and progression frameworks, ensuring fair and consistent outcomes.
  + Maintain compliance with EU Pay Transparency requirements and related audits and reporting.
  + Lead the performance review cycle across all entities, including manager enablement, calibration, and consistent, well-documented outcomes.
  + Design and continuously improve performance frameworks, ensuring successful rollout and adoption.
* **Workforce Planning & Organisational Effectiveness:**
  + Partner directly with Finance to build and maintain workforce planning models, budget-to-actuals tracking, and headcount reporting.
  + Provide the data and process rigour needed to support organisational design and restructuring decisions.
* **Creating and Engaging Workplace & Culture:**
  + Ensure the smooth running of our offices in Frankfurt, New Jersey, Hyderabad, and Barcelona, creating environments that support productivity, community, and employee well-being.
  + Lead culture and key company initiatives, including global and local office events.

#### **Main requirements:**

* 7+ years in people, HR, or shared services roles, with direct, hands-on ownership of talent acquisition, performance management, payroll, HRIS, and compliance.
* Experience in high-change environments. Multi-country and multi-entity experience is a strong plus.
* Comfortable managing complexity across multiple jurisdictions. Practical experience with Spanish and/or German labor law is a strong plus.
* A track record of personally owning the operational execution of people processes at scale, and of managing teams across multiple locations.
* Tech-savvy with a mindset for adopting AI, automation, and process optimization.
* Fluent English is required. Spanish and/or German are a plus.
* An organized, structured thinker with a pragmatic approach to finding solutions in a fast-paced environment.

#### **Salary:**

At Qualifyze, our salary ranges are transparent internally, and we aim to follow a similar approach externally. For this role, we’re happy to share a reference point within the band: the expected salary range is around **80,000 - 85,000 €**, centred around the median.

Final compensation will depend on experience and performance during the process, with some flexibility within the range.

#### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package
* Country vacation package that increases with your tenure
* ️ Country specific benefits offering incl.private health care, fitness and meal allowances
* Annual personal development budget to increase your impact
* Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.
* All the best kit and tools to work effectively
* Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe
* Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career

#### **Use of AI in Our Recruitment Process:**

We believe in a humanled hiring process. All applications are reviewed manually by our Talent Acquisition team, and neither Talent Acquisition nor Hiring Managers use AI to screen, filter, rank, assess, or make decisions about candidates, including during interviews and assessments. During interviews, AI may be used only to support note-taking and transcription. All hiring decisions are made by people!

#### **Diversity & Inclusion at Qualifyze:**

At Qualifyze, we value diversity and inclusion, recognizing the strength that complementary talents and perspectives bring to our team. Join us and help drive innovation, tackle challenges, and create meaningful change. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

title: MATH Faculty Member - MATH
description:
**Seville Faculty Member: Math JD**

On-site - Seville | Verto Education  
Learn more about us:  
https://vertoeducation.org/abroad-locations/study-abroad-spain/

**About Verto**

Verto is on a mission to provide the best possible start to college. We make travel and experiential education a core part of the first year, enabling students to begin their academic journey overseas before transferring to one of 70+ partner universities in the United States.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
* Accurately calculate and submit grades on-time through the LMS and via the Academic Provider’s grade reporting software (Banner), following established mid-term and end-of-term grade reporting timelines and protocols. Respond to student inquiries related to their grades in a timely manner including any grade disputes or discrepancies after the final grading period.
* Foster learning environments that are respectful and positive, conducive to early college student development, adhere to Verto values, and that are characterized by learner-centered approaches to instructional design and delivery:
  + Helping students develop their academic identity and foundational academic skills with appropriate levels of challenge and support
  + Appropriate use of professional language and tone, modeling constructive feedback and conflict negotiation
  + Active classroom management and consideration of power dynamics in faculty-student relationships
  + Auditing course materials for representation for diverse student populations by including bringing in local and global perspectives through course readings, assignments, and activities.
* Build and maintain positive, collaborative, and professional relationships with program participants, staff, and community partners.
* Share feedback with local and global Verto academic leaders to provide recommendations for academic excellence and faculty support needs.
* Participate in curriculum development projects and assessment initiatives as directed by the University of New Haven and Verto Edcuation.
* Other duties as reasonably assigned.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. Faculty are an integral part of helping new college students build appropriate academic skills and will integrate academic skill building into courses and help identify growth opportunities for learners.

Candidates must be dynamic educators who are motivated by working with a first-year student population and building professional relationships with students and peers to support student engagement and academic success. Faculty will participate in academic and professional development training prior to, and throughout, the semester to support teaching and learning. Faculty are required to utilize the established academic policies and daily reporting tools for attendance, as described. All faculty will develop and lead active and experiential learning activities as part of the curriculum.

* Faculty who are intellectually curious and motivated, and are skilled in teaching concepts in various settings (e.g., in or outside of the classroom).
* Faculty who demonstrate genuine care about students and ability to connect and engage students in learning.
* Faculty who are willing to go that extra mile to support students' success in their start to their new college career.
* Faculty who excel at and love teaching, and are also willing to learn from their students and colleagues.
* Faculty who are versatile and flexible to meet dynamic and changing environments.
* Faculty who demonstrate high levels of professionalism and commitment and are open to continuous learning and development.
* Verto seeks faculty who can be a bridge to the local culture and help bring learning to life for students above all else.
  

**Application Instructions**

To apply, please submit the following:

* Cover Letter - a letter of interest (no more than 2 pages) that articulates your experience and qualifications in relation to the job description. Please share your specific experience with US higher education and higher education systems in the country where you are applying to teach, and share examples of active and experiential learning and how you support diverse learners' needs.

* Current Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* References - Names and contact information of three references who will provide a professional recommendation.
* Unofficial transcripts of graduate work. If your graduate degree was conferred from an institution that doesn’t traditionally issue transcripts, please upload a scanned copy of your diploma.
* Teaching evaluations from related courses / up to three separate semesters, if available.

Faculty will be asked to share a schedule of availability and complete a background check as part of the hiring process. All faculty are subject to final review and approval by the University of New Haven.
  
  
**Enrollment Sizes & Course Details**

Course assignments are typically 45 hours (3 U.S. credits) or 60 hours (4 U.S. credit) courses, depending on the course and discipline (4 credit/60 hours are typical for Lab or Studio based courses).

Faculty may be invited to teach multiple sections of the same course, when possible, and/or multiple courses directly related to their academic field of expertise, if related courses are available.

Course syllabi are developed and approved by the Academic Provider, along with specific information regarding course learning outcomes, academic policies, assessment of learning, and overall expectations. Faculty typically develop their own teaching materials, including schedule, readings, assignments, experiential learning activities, and develop and manage a course site via the Learning Management System, Canvas. Some courses are delivered in a sequential manner (e.g. BIOL I & II) or offered across all locations (e.g. ENGL 1112) and may have required course textbooks, common assignments or assessments, or other materials that are standard for course delivery.

Section enrollment varies by program location, scheduling, student enrollment, and classroom size. Specific information will be provided by the local program staff.

* Language courses: Approximately 15-18 students
* Non-language courses: Approximately 15-24 students
Lab courses: Typically fewer than 25 students  

**Why Join Verto?**  
***The below are for full-time Employees in the United States (benefits for international staff benefits vary by location and meet or exceed local standards)***

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation reimagining higher education
* ✈️ Work in a globally-minded, international environment
* Exposure to cross-functional teams (academics, operations, student life)
* Opportunity to grow in a fast-moving, impact-driven organisation

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**Compensation**

description:
