title: Senior System Designer - Mob Control
description:
**About Voodoo**
================

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

**Team**
========

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will join **Mob Control**, key title of Voodoo, with more than 230M installs and 14 MAU.

**Role**
========

As a Senior Game Designer for Mob Control, you will own the design and execution of new features and game improvements of all sizes. You will also collaborate with a Product Director in shaping the strategy and roadmap for your unit. Your mission is to help evolve the game, with the ultimate goal of turning Mob Control into a top-performing title in the midcore game market.

* **Design features & systems**: Create new core loops and meta systems to drive engagement, social dynamics, and monetization. Develop designs, user flows, and economy models, and propose A/B test ideas.
* **Collaborate across teams**: Partner with product managers, engineers, and artists to bring features from concept to live release, aligning gameplay, UX, and visuals.
* **Leverage player insights**: Analyze KPIs and player behavior to inform design choices and identify opportunities to boost retention, engagement, and IAP monetization.
* **Contribute to vision & strategy**: Participate in defining the overall game vision, strategic direction, and long-term roadmap alongside product directors and studio leadership. Help shape priorities and ensure design decisions align with studio goals.

**Profile**
===========

* 5+ years of experience in mobile midcore games (strategy, 4X, or similar); 10+ years is a strong plus.
* Proven track record in gameplay design, balancing, and meta feature design.
* Strong communication skills, with a focus in creating clear, simple design documentation.
* Ability to absorb and apply feedback from multiple sources with flexibility and no ego.
* Skilled at simplifying and communicating complex systems.
* Comfortable analyzing KPIs and player behavior to guide design decisions.
* Passion for mobile midcore games and deep knowledge of market dynamics.
* AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

**Benefits**
============

* Best-in-class compensation
* Other benefits according to the country you reside

title: Product Director
description:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC ("Zone") is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

**About the Job:**

Zone & Co. is seeking a Director of Procure-to-Pay Product Suite to define, build, and scale our flagship platform. As the strategic leader of this product area, you will set the vision, drive innovation, and lead a high-performing team to deliver transformative solutions for global businesses. This is a unique opportunity for a product executive with a proven track record or exceptional potential to shape the future of enterprise financial operations.

AI is changing what technology can do. We want someone who knows the problem space to see where it is heading, and who builds with AI to get there first.

#### **What You'll Do:**

Define and communicate a bold, actionable product vision and strategy for the Procure-to-Pay suite, aligned with Zone & Co.'s overall business goals and market opportunities.  

Lead, mentor, and empower a high-performing team of product managers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and customer focus.  
Own and scale the product roadmap, ensuring seamless integration of procurement and payment workflows that drive measurable value for customers.  
Translate customer feedback, market trends, and competitive insights into data-driven product decisions and prioritization.  
Champion design excellence by delivering intuitive, user-centric solutions that elevate the customer experience and differentiate our offerings.  
Collaborate closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and executive leadership to align vision and execution, from ideation to launch.  
* Serve as a visible product leader—representing the Procure to Pay suite in customer conversations, internal leadership forums, and industry events.

#### **What You'll Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Product Management, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* 10+ years of experience in product management, with deep expertise in Accounts Payable (AP) automation and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) solutions.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end AP workflows, including the day-to-day needs of AP teams and the strategic priorities of CFOs.
* Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and successfully bringing them to market.
* Strong ownership and initiative, with the ability to drive outcomes end to end, act proactively, and identify and address challenges early.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adapt quickly, and adjust priorities based on customer feedback, data, and market insights.
* Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and market opportunities.
* Proven experience leading and developing product teams, with excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with peers and executive leadership.

The base salary range for this position is €10,000 – €128,000 GBP + bonus + equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and education, as well as market and business considerations.

**Benefits**

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it's the standard. We're looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

**Join Our Global Mission**

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

**Employment Terms**

**United States**

Employment with Zone is **"At-Will"**, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

**Non-US Jurisdictions**

This position is offered as a Fixed-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence. Employment is subject to a written contract which outlines specific notice periods, probationary terms, and statutory entitlements.

title: Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product
description:
**Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

**Why this role matters:**
--------------------------

BSS Engineering and Product is a critical enabler of Vonage's commercial platform, ensuring our business support systems are scalable, reliable, commercially aligned, and able to support growth across products, regions, and customer segments. As Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product, you will lead the global BSS function across engineering ownership, product direction, platform strategy, and delivery for billing, rating, provisioning, ordering, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations.

  

**Your key responsibilities:**
------------------------------

**BSS Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the global BSS engineering organization, owning architecture, delivery, quality, resilience, technical standards, and platform performance across core BSS systems
* Define engineering practices across solution design, integration, release management, test automation, observability, and technical debt management
* Ensure BSS platforms support scale, availability, security, compliance, and the needs of a multi-product, multi-region commercial model.

**BSS Product Ownership & Roadmap**

* Own the BSS product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing capabilities against commercial, customer, operational, regulatory, and finance needs
* Translate business requirements into a clear product backlog across billing, rating, mediation, ordering, CPQ, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations
* Establish governance, prioritization forums, success measures, and communication rhythms, including the use of AI-enabled insight and automation to improve delivery, decision-making, and platform optimisation.

**Team Leadership & Operating Cadence**

* Lead and develop a global BSS Engineering and Product team, including engineering managers, product owners, platform leads, architects, and delivery specialists
* Run an effective operating cadence across roadmap planning, delivery governance, platform health, stakeholder prioritisation, risk management, and product delivery progress
Build organisational capability through hiring, succession planning, team structure design, globally distributed delivery, and practical AI enablement across engineering and product ways of working.  

**What you'll bring:**
----------------------

**Required:**

* Senior BSS engineering and product leadership experience in global telecommunications, CPaaS, cloud communications, or enterprise SaaS
* Deep BSS domain expertise, including platforms such as Amdocs, Oracle Communications, CSGi, NetCracker, Zuora, Optiva, Salesforce CPQ, or equivalent
* Experience leading BSS platform delivery, including migrations, integrations, data improvement, release planning, and API-led or cloud-native architectures where appropriate
* Strong product ownership capability, with experience translating commercial, finance, regulatory, operational, and customer needs into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes
* Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, product, architecture, and delivery teams in a matrixed environment, with a track record of using AI, automation, or data-driven tooling to improve productivity, quality, and platform outcomes.

**Experience we consider a plus:**

* Experience in CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or Tier 1/Tier 2 telecommunications
Experience with API monetisation, partner billing, usage-based charging, subscription management, or digital self-service.  

**How you'll benefit**
----------------------

* Private Medical Insurance: Adeslas
* Group Pension Plan: Generali
* Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident: VidaCaixa
* Ericsson Care Line
* Discretionary Time Off (DTO)/Hourly Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Volunteer Time (VTO)
* Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our **Privacy Notice**.

**Who we are:**

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

title: Lead CRA Manager
description:
**WHY CHOOSE MEDSIR**

We are a Barcelona-based fastest-growing company founded by scientific experts . We are dedicated to the design and management of innovative strategic clinical trials in oncology, from study conception to the publication of study results . Together, we create the best strategies that are both clinically relevant and scientifically meaningful . We strive to improve our knowledge of this complex disease and the vast array of available treatments in a fast-innovative way .

At MEDSIR, you will have the job of your life while working together towards our shared mission bringing novel treatments to cancer patients worldwide. We welcome top performers that will bring new ideas, diverse perspectives, and provide you the opportunities and freedom to grow and make a real impact in patients' lives and science… all while having great fun

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY:**

The Lead CRA Manager is responsible for resource planning, performance management, capability development, engagement, and the effective resolution of complex operational issues. The role provides strategic direction to the team, translates business and study priorities into team objectives, and ensures consistent delivery across studies.

The Lead CRA Manager reports directly to the Patient Management Director.

**HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE:**

* Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) Oversight: Ensure appropriate oversight of IMP forecasting, shipments, supply continuity, and chain-of-custody documentation. Provide direction on complex site or vendor discrepancies and ensure timely escalation and resolution of material risks.
* Quality, Data & Documentation Oversight: Establish and monitor quality expectations for site files, regulatory documentation, and ISFs, ensuring consistent adherence to GCP, internal procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements. Review trends and define corrective actions when quality standards are not met.
* Stakeholder Leadership: Build effective relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including International Trial Leads, QA, Regulatory, CRAs, sites, and vendors.
* Monitoring Strategy & Site Support: Provide strategic oversight of monitoring plans, risk-based monitoring approaches, visit reporting standards, and escalation pathways. Ensure the Lead CRA team applies consistent practices and that complex site-management issues are addressed effectively.
* People Leadership & Team Management: Lead and manage the Lead CRA team, setting clear objectives, priorities, and accountability. Conduct regular one-to-ones and performance and development conversations, provide ongoing feedback and mentoring, support career development, and foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.
* Training & Development: Design training frameworks for PML team ensuring continuous development and harmonized practices across studies. Provide onboarding for new team members.
* Risk & Issue Management: Guide the PML Team in identifying and mitigating risks, guiding CAPA development and follow-up.
* Process Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Lead CRA activities. Collect feedback from the team and stakeholders to implement streamlined, standardized practices.
* Operational Oversight: Monitor workload distribution across Lead CRA team, ensuring balance and efficiency. Anticipate resource needs and collaborate with Patient Management Manager for adequate staffing.

**WHAT DO WE VALUE FOR THIS OPPORTUNITY?**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Clinical Research, Pharmacy, or a related field.
* Significant experience in clinical trial coordination, site management, or regulatory oversight, including responsibility for complex studies.
* Strong understanding of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), ICH guidelines, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and motivate team members.
* Strong leadership, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage complex operational issues, competing priorities, and escalations.
* Proven capability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and maintain stringent trial timelines.
* Proven capacity to balance operational detail with strategic oversight.
* Strong organisational, workforce planning, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to prioritise across a complex clinical trial.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and clinical trial management systems (CTMS, EDC, etc.).
* Fluent in both Spanish and English.

**THE THINGS YOU REALLY WANNA KNOW** :

At MEDSIR, we believe that employees today want to evolve in collaborative, high-growth environments where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We are convinced that employees need to find alignment between their inner values and their company’s culture and mission to unlock their full potential. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning and growth where everyone can bring expertise, own projects and easily measure their impact.

**BENEFITS**

Work with world-renowned clinicians and KOL´s on high-level publications and papers.

Fast growth, we are an early-stage company with a multidisciplinary team and many growth opportunities.

Work-life balance - hybrid working model and flexible hours focusing on performance rather than office hours.

Unlimited access to GoodHabitz courses and regular workshops (external & internal) to continue your development.

Opportunities to participate in scientific conferences & events at national and international level.

Private health Insurance.

Work-from-abroad policy depending on position and local legislation.

A young & international team with a company culture focused on development.

Positive, dynamic, and passionate work environment.

Elevate your wellness with Wellhub (formerly GymPass)! One subscription for the best in fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep support—all in one place.

"Flexible compensation plan" to help you save taxes and increase your net salary (Cobee).

A free day on your birthday so you can truly celebrate!

Unforgettable MEDSIR events and regular get togethers.

Equal employment opportunity, at MEDSIR we proudly pursue a diverse workforce and celebrate our differences.

A fantastic workplace located near Sagrada Familia.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all individuals are treated with respect and equality, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic. title: Account Manager
description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 347 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ approximately 13,000 people and operate in 60 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.  
  
What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities May Include:**

* Build and sustain strong customer relationships across a portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for inquiries, issue resolution, and satisfaction.
* Identify growth opportunities and pursue new business leads, increasing revenue through strategic initiatives such as expansion and pricing optimizations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Sales, Operations, Category Management) to design and execute strategic plans that support customer growth, cost efficiency, and business ease.
* Conduct regular business reviews, manage tenders, and negotiate contracts, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
* Monitor account performance through key metrics and customer feedback (e.g., NPS), implementing strategies to enhance customer experience and loyalty.
* Oversee the annual audit process, ensuring compliance with CHEP’s policies and recovering any outstanding equipment fees.
* Lead initiatives aimed at reducing transport costs and improving supply chain efficiency, driving value for customers and optimizing operational processes.
* Support the integration of sustainability initiatives with customers, contributing to CHEP’s broader corporate social responsibility objectives.

**Position Purpose:**

The purpose of this position is to evaluate and make improvements to business processes for Asset Productivity.

The role is to ensure the efficiency of business operations and create and implement changes or improvements as needed, aligning processes with the organization's strategic goals, designing, and implementing process architectures, establishing process measurement systems that align with organizational goals, and educating and organizing managers so that they will manage processes effectively.

Strong focus is required on standardization and best practice sharing. Will have strong interaction with AP leaders in the regions.

**Major/ Key Accountabilities:**

* Manage CHEP’s relationship across a portfolio of CHEP’s Fres customers
* Work alongside the relevant Account Directors to formulate a business plan for each customer account to protect and grow the account in order to meet and exceed annual targets.
* Identification and conversion of growth opportunities (LE & NB).
* Execute audit program in line with CHEP annual audit plan.
* Build networks and relationships with stakeholders at all levels within customers’ supply chains & other departments.
* Develop and implement joint strategic plans with key customers addressing topics such as growth, cost reduction, sustainability, digital, transport collaboration, FMS, LMS and ease of business.
* Drive improved customer satisfaction and engagement.
* Manage commercial tender and contract negotiations with customers

**Qualifications:**

University Degree (Business/Economic preferable).

**Experience**:

A minimum of 5 years experience in a customer facing, field-based role.

**Skills & Knowledge:**

Customer Focus & Analytical Skills are a must.

Strong networking, relationship building and inter-personal skills

Excellent commercial negotiation and presentation skills.

Salesforce user

Familiarity with CHEP’s value proposition

Proficient use of MS Office

Supply Chain Mapping

**Languages:**

Spanish and English

**Location:** Madrid or Barcelona

===============

Hybrid Remote

=================================

Account Management, Adaptability, Building Rapport, Commercial Sustainability, Customer Experience (CX), Customer Partnerships, Data Storytelling, Digital Customer Solutions (Dcs), Empathy, Experimenting, Negotiation, Our Business, Relationship Management, Sales Communications, Taking Ownership, Teamwork, Understand Customers, Value Propositions

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Terra’s Creative team is a tight-knit, collaborative group that thrives on solving diverse creative problems for our clients. We are seeking an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer with a strong portfolio, exceptional design skills, and a passion for creating intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling digital experiences.

This role is ideal for a designer with 5+ years of professional experience who is ready to take greater ownership of complex website projects, contribute to strategic design decisions, and help elevate the quality of work across the team.

As a Senior UX/UI Designer, you will independently lead the design execution of assigned projects, from initial concepts and wireframes through high-fidelity designs and developer handoff. You'll collaborate closely with creative leadership, project managers, developers, and other designers to deliver thoughtful, user-centered solutions that balance functionality, aesthetics, and client objectives.

You will also play an important role in maintaining high design standards, contributing to client presentations, and providing guidance and constructive feedback to fellow designers, without formal team management responsibilities.

Portfolio required for consideration.

### **Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of professional experience in a UX/UI design role, ideally at an agency or in a fast-paced, client-focused environment, with a strong portfolio showcasing intuitive, visually compelling, and user-centered digital experiences.
* You are proactive, highly organized, and capable of independently managing complex design assignments, balancing multiple priorities, and meeting deadlines.
* You have strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to articulate design decisions and explain your creative rationale to internal stakeholders and clients.
* You have a proficient level of English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
* You are highly proficient in Figma, with extensive experience in wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, and scalable design systems.
* You have a strong understanding of UX/UI principles, information architecture, interaction design, and responsive design, paired with a keen eye for typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and detail.
* You have a solid understanding of web development principles, including HTML5, CSS3, front-end capabilities and limitations, and web accessibility standards (WCAG AA).
* You are a strategic and creative problem solver who can balance user needs, business objectives, and technical requirements to develop thoughtful design solutions.
* You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy giving and receiving constructive feedback, and are comfortable guiding fellow designers while remaining adaptable to other creative disciplines, including graphic and editorial design.

### **What You'll Do**

* Take ownership of the UX/UI design process for assigned website and digital projects, from initial discovery and concept development through final execution and developer handoff.
* Collaborate with creative leadership, project managers, strategists, designers, and developers to translate client objectives, project scopes, brand guidelines, and technical requirements into effective design solutions.
* Conduct design research and develop information architecture, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes to explore and validate design concepts.
* Design responsive, intuitive, and visually compelling websites and digital interfaces that balance usability, accessibility, visual storytelling, and business goals.
* Develop, maintain, and improve UI design systems, component libraries, and design patterns to ensure consistency, scalability, and efficiency across digital experiences.
* Work closely with developers throughout implementation, providing clear design specifications, supporting handoffs, and resolving UX/UI challenges to ensure design quality and feasibility.
* Participate in and help guide internal design reviews and client presentations, communicating design concepts, rationale, and recommendations.
* Guide fellow designers through specific projects or design challenges, providing constructive feedback and helping maintain high standards of design quality and consistency.
* Proactively coordinate with project leads to manage timelines, communicate progress, identify potential challenges, and ensure deliverables meet project requirements and client expectations.
* Stay current with emerging UX/UI trends, tools, and technologies, sharing inspiration, best practices, and opportunities to improve design processes and workflows.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* 15 observed holidays + 23 PTO days per year
* Indefinite contract following a trial period of 6 months
* Permanent remote work
* Dedicated team budget for professional development
* Compensated onsite retreats at our Bilbao HQ
* Access to Wellhub – a wellness benefit with access to thousands of gyms and studios and online classes
* The opportunity to join a dynamic, close-knit team that loves going to work with and for each other every day

Salary will be commensurate with experience and geographic location.

**About Terra**

Terra is a digital marketing and creative agency built by an integrated and international team of content creators, strategists, designers, and developers. We help organizations reimagine and deliver their most ambitious digital projects and initiatives by acting as an extension of our clients’ teams and delivering exceptional online experiences, content, and marketing strategies.

Our team is innovative, tech-forward, and creative by nature. We are dedicated to pushing boundaries and staying ahead of the curve in today’s ever-evolving digital landscape. We believe in the power of collaboration and foster a work environment that encourages creativity and growth. And with a strong focus on work-life balance, we prioritize the well-being and career development of our team members. Finally, we are committed to promoting from within and offering meaningful opportunities for professional growth.

**Terra is also an equal opportunity employer.**

We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote team members regardless of their race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status (as required by applicable law).

Our top goal as an employer is to bring together a diverse mix of talented people who are excited to join our company, stay with Terra for a long time, and do their best work while they’re here. We take pride in the quality of the services and work we provide to our clients, and we know none of it is possible without the hard work and commitment of our passionate and creative employees.

title: Senior eCommerce Content Strategist
description:
**About Us**  
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.  
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Content Audits & Quality Assessment**  

* Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
* Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
* Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

**Content Strategy Development**  

* Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
* Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
* Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
* Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
* Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

**AI & Agentic Discoverability**  

* AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
* Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
* Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

**Testing & Performance Monitoring**  

* A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
* Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
* Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

**Creative Briefing & Review**  

* Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and

marketplace advertising content.  

* Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
* Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

**Client Management**  

* Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
* Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
* Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
* Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
* Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

**Quality & Output Review**  

* Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

**AI-Enabled Working**  

* AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
* Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

* Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

* Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

* Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

* Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

* Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

* Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

* Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

* Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats.

* Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle.

* Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.

* Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.

**Desirable**

* Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms.

* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.

* Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.

* Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

**Benefits**
------------

**What We Offer**  

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Hybrid Working Model
* Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team
* Continuous learning & career development
* The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces

We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Youtube Strategist & Channel Manager
description:
**TheSoul Group** is a leading creator business platform positioned at the heart of the creator economy. Our original videos, animations, and editorial stories inspire audiences in **21 languages**, across **60 platforms** and **20 websites**.  
Together with our network of **talented creators**, we reach over **5 billion followers** and generate more than **100 billion monthly views** on social media.

As a global powerhouse in digital media, we drive viral success for creators and brands worldwide through a wide range of services, leveraging our expertise in content distribution, localization, and social media management. We’re the creators behind global phenomena such as **5-Minute Crafts** and **BrightSide**.

We’re a dynamic, remote-first global team, fostering award-winning creativity, a no-red-tape approach, and great vibes!  
  
TheSoul Group is launching the YouTube channel for an established TV series in the food and outdoor space, bringing its content to a new digital audience.

YouTube is the main stage, and **views and subscribers are the KPIs that matter most**. TikTok, Instagram and Facebook grow alongside it, both as channels in their own right and as a way to send viewers to YouTube.

As our **YouTube Strategist & Channel Manager**, you'll set the strategy and run the channel day to day. You read the data, decide what comes next, and work hand in hand with a dedicated editor so every new video builds on what performs.

**Strategy & data**

* Track channel performance weekly: views, subscribers, retention, CTR, traffic sources and returning viewers
* Turn insights into **clear, data-led briefs for the editor**: which topics and moments to use, which hooks to test, what length works best
* Find the formats and topics the audience responds to, and adjust the plan to match
* Lead the channel to **YouTube monetisation eligibility** and track progress against it

**Running the channel**

* Support the channel and account setup for a **US audience**; set up playlists, keywords and a standard for titles and descriptions
* Own the publishing calendar: **2 long-form videos and 14 Shorts a week** on YouTube, plus regular posting on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook
* Grow TikTok, Instagram and Facebook: adapt content per platform and test formats, posting times and captions
* Write titles, descriptions and captions; brief thumbnails and A/B test them every week
* Refresh underperforming videos with a new title, thumbnail or opening
* Spot trends early and bring relevant ideas into the plan
* Prepare cuts for client review and approval in Frame.io

**Community**

* Manage comments and messages across all platforms daily
* Build an engaged community and turn recurring questions and feedback into content ideas

  
**Requirements**  

* **3+ years growing YouTube channels hands-on**, both long-form and Shorts, with before-and-after numbers to show for it
* Strong analytics skills, and the ability to turn data into clear creative direction for an editor
* Comfortable owning both strategy and daily execution: posting, copywriting, titles and community management
* Hands-on experience growing **TikTok and Instagram** accounts, including setting up accounts for a specific country
* Highly organised: able to run a high-volume calendar with client approvals
* Senior enough to work directly with the client: explaining and defending decisions and handling feedback with confidence
* Available for a couple of hours' overlap with **US Pacific time** when needed
* Experience turning existing **TV, film or podcast content** into YouTube content (a strong plus)
* Background in **food, travel or outdoor** niches
* Knowledge of YouTube's advertiser-friendly guidelines for hunting, fishing and animal-processing footage
* Experience with brand integrations
* Fluent English

  
**Benefits**  

* **Flexible Engagement Structure:** This opportunity is offered under an independent service-provider agreement, giving you the freedom to shape how you deliver your expertise. You define your own working methods, organise your schedule independently, and contribute your skills to clearly scoped projects. Compensation is agreed individually and reflects your experience, capabilities, and the value you bring to each engagement.
* **Location Freedom:** You can deliver services from any suitable location that supports high-quality outcomes, whether that’s your home office, a co-working space, or wherever you feel most productive and inspired. What matters most is the impact you create and the reliability of your delivery.
* **Global Network and Inspiring Projects:** You’ll collaborate with a diverse international network of professionals across 85+ countries, contributing to projects that reach vast audiences and help shape the future of digital content. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented specialists, exchange ideas, and be part of meaningful initiatives with real global reach.
* **Smooth Collaboration and Project Support:** To enable efficient service delivery, we provide modern collaboration platforms, clear project coordination, and streamlined processes. This helps you focus your energy where it matters most, producing high-impact work and bringing creative solutions to life.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise will contribute to initiatives that influence audiences worldwide. Join projects that push creative boundaries and help build the next generation of digital experiences.

We appreciate your interest in our job opportunities and our company. Our team carefully evaluates each application to identify the most suitable candidates for the role. Due to the high volume of applications received, we may not be able to respond to every applicant. However, if your qualifications align with our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the next steps in the selection process.

title: Senior Lifecycle & Retention Strategist - Klaviyo & Shopify Agency (Remote)
description:
Paired is a global recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

About Our Clients

*We are a recruiting partner representing* ***three leading, fast-growing e-commerce retention agencies*** *currently scaling their teams. By applying to this single role, you will be considered for three distinct agency dynamics depending on your background and career goals:*

They are looking for experienced **Lifecycle & Retention Growth Strategists** who can take ownership of customer retention, lifecycle marketing, and growth initiatives.

* **The Enterprise Scale Agency:** Best for strategists who love global teams, structured multi-person account pods, and managing high-profile global brand portfolios.
* **The Agile Boutique Studio:** Best for autonomous, execution-focused strategists who love working closely with founders and driving rapid list growth for 7-figure brands.
* **The Data & Tech-Heavy Growth Shop:** Best for analytical minds who love custom data pipelines, proprietary funnel architectures, and leveraging advanced AI production tools.

This is a strategic, hands-on role for someone who understands how to turn customer and performance data into actions that improve revenue, retention, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

Depending on the client, your scope may include email and SMS marketing, lifecycle automation, retention strategy, subscription growth, customer journeys, experimentation, and cross-functional team leadership.

Key responsibilities

* Own lifecycle and retention strategy across email, SMS, subscription, and other customer touchpoints based on business needs.
* Analyze customer, campaign, retention, and revenue data to identify opportunities and determine what should be tested or optimized.
* Develop and execute experiments around offers, messaging, segmentation, customer journeys, subscription conversion, retention, and lifecycle engagement.
* Build and optimize lifecycle programs, including campaigns, automated flows, onboarding, post-purchase, winback, cancellation/save journeys, and other retention initiatives.
* Translate data and customer behavior into clear strategic recommendations and actionable plans.
* Own performance against key business outcomes such as revenue, retention, customer lifetime value, subscription take rate, churn, or lifecycle program performance.
* Work directly with clients, founders, or senior stakeholders to present performance, recommendations, and strategic priorities.
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams including copywriters, designers, project managers, developers, and other marketing specialists.
* Provide clear briefs, direction, feedback, and quality control to ensure execution aligns with strategy and brand requirements.
* Troubleshoot lifecycle marketing, CRM, subscription, or customer journey issues and provide practical solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and workflows, including the use of AI and automation where appropriate.
* Monitor account/customer health and proactively identify risks, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Help build scalable playbooks, processes, and best practices that improve lifecycle and retention performance across the business.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, retention marketing, CRM, growth marketing, email/SMS marketing, subscription growth, or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of DTC/ecommerce, consumer, subscription, or digital businesses and how customer retention contributes to revenue and profitability.
* Proven experience using data to make strategic marketing or growth decisions rather than simply executing predefined campaigns.
* Strong experience with lifecycle marketing platforms such as Klaviyo or comparable CRM/marketing automation tools.
* Hands-on understanding of customer segmentation, automated journeys/flows, retention programs, experimentation, and performance optimization.
* Experience owning measurable business outcomes such as revenue, retention, churn, LTV, conversion, subscription growth, or lifecycle performance.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate performance data into clear recommendations and next actions.
* Comfortable working directly with clients, founders, CMOs, or senior stakeholders and communicating recommendations with confidence.
* Strong project ownership and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.
* Able to work cross-functionally and direct or collaborate with creative, project management, development, and marketing teams.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills suitable for client-facing work.
* Self-directed, commercially minded, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-moving environments.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership mentality; you check your own work and take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve marketing workflows, analysis, content development, or operational efficiency is a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive USD compensation based on experience and client requirements.
* Remote flexibility – work from anywhere while collaborating with international teams.
* Opportunities to work with international companies across ecommerce, DTC, subscription, and digital businesses.
* High-ownership roles with exposure to strategy, experimentation, and business growth.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**What we're building**
=======================

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

**Why join Shadow?**
====================

* **Product Ownership** You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.
* **Shape the Engineering Culture** You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring.
* **Work with Challenger Consumer Brands** Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue.

**The agency behind the product**
=================================

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**The role**
============

You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself.  
You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it.  
You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar.

**Core Tech & Tools**

* **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript)
* **Datastore:** PostgreSQL
* **Cloud & Infra:** Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
* **ML/AI:** LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it.
* Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand.
* Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next.
* Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it.
* Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states.
* Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days.
* Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing.
* Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds.
* Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners.

**Must haves**
==============

* Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code.
* Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components.
* Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions.
* Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request.
* A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it.
* Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma.
* Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information.
* Daily use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with opinions on how AI products should feel.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You’d rather ship and learn than polish in private.
* Clear writing. You can explain the why behind a design to engineers, experts and non-designers.
* Most people who fit this have 5+ years across design and some experience with frontend engineering.

**Nice to haves**
=================

* Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing work, or research with expert users.
* You’ve built a design system that other engineers rely on.
* Data visualization work in D3, Visx, Recharts or hand-rolled SVG.
* Motion work, such as spring animation or Framer Motion.
* Experience with LLM APIs, streaming interfaces or agent products.
* Time spent around marketing, ecommerce or analytics tools, or running ads yourself.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every employee exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

We are an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing

Town Web · HeyGov  
Remote · Full-time contractor

**The Quick Version**

Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts?

We did!

Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry!

Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring.

Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.

Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.

Here's a video to tell you more about this role!

**The details**

Who we are

We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.

Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)

We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.

What you'll own

* Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
* Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured.
* Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
* Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
* The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
* Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.

Who does well here

Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? Are you “THE ONE?”

We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.

And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.

AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.

This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.

What we need to see

* Exceptional Enthusiasm
* Extremely Creative Energy
* You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
* You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
* AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
* Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
* Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
* B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!

How to apply

* Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
* There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!

  
**Requirements**  
  
**IMPORTANT**

* Only applications submitted through the proper channel, which is Workable, will be processed.
* Taking the CultureIndex Survey is a requirement, we will not respond to any applications submitted without this.

title: GEO Specialist
description:
GEO Specialist

The GEO Specialist supports the strategy and execution of Generative Engine Optimization programs for a portfolio of B2B clients. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

GEO Research & Execution

* Research and document the prompts, questions, and content gaps that matter most for each client's audience and competitive position.

* Contribute to AI visibility benchmarking — tracking how clients are cited across LLMs and the AI Search space relative to competitors.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of GEO strategies, execution scopes, and client-facing reporting assets.

On-Site Content Planning & Support

* Create content plans which support AI citation
* Audit existing client content for GEO alignment and flag restructuring opportunities that could improve AI Visibility.
* Collaborate with writing and strategy teams to ensure content plans are executable and successful

Reddit Strategy

* Develop and manage Reddit strategies that build client visibility & presence in the community content sources AI models reference.
* Identify the right subreddits, content angles, and participation strategies for each client's audience and objectives.
* Plan platform-native content that earns upvotes & citation — understanding what Reddit culture demands vs. what traditional marketing assumes.
* Support the strategy which drives authentic Reddit presence including organic participation, strategic comment engagement, and branded posts where appropriate.

Performance & Reporting

* Track client KPIs including AI visibility, citation share, share of voice, AI referral traffic, prompt coverage, and Reddit engagement metrics.
* Contribute to regular performance reports with clear documentation of what's working, what isn't, and what to test next.
* Support ongoing testing across content formats, subreddit selection, post framing, and content structure.

Cross-Channel Integration

* Collaborate with creative, SEO, and senior GEO team members to ensure Reddit and on-site activity supports broader channel strategies.
* Surface audience insights — trending topics, community sentiment, competitive signals — and feed them into client content planning.
* Participate in client content audits and strategy sessions with a GEO and AI Visibility lens.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

Execution Quality

* Post-handoff survey: senior strategists and execution teams rate brief clarity and deliverable quality 1–5 (target 4).

Client Satisfaction

description:
**About Hub OS**

Hub OS is transforming how hotels operate. We're not just another communication tool. We're a complete operations system that manages everything from housekeeping and maintenance to guest requests and interdepartmental workflows, all in one platform.

Since 2015, we've helped 2,000 properties across 80 countries deliver great guest experiences with maximum efficiency. Our clients include iconic brands like Accor, IHG, Minor Hotels, Hesperia World and Eurostars Hotels, among others.

**About the role**

Marketing is one of the best ways for us to grow, and we want to build it the right way. That's why we're looking for a Marketing Manager. Reporting to the VP of Growth, you'll own marketing end to end: strategy, brand, demand generation, content, customer stories, sales materials and events.

Our goal is simple. We want more hotels to know us, trust us and ask for a demo. You'll be responsible for building our brand and our visibility, turning that into inbound leads, and giving our Sales team the stories and materials that help them close deals faster.

This is a hands-on role. You'll define the strategy, and you'll also create, publish and measure the work yourself, using AI tools to move fast. You'll be our first dedicated marketing lead with a global scope, with a clear path to lead a team as the company grows.

You'll play a critical role in shaping how the hotel industry sees Hub OS.

**Your mission:**

Marketing Strategy & Brand

* Define and own the annual marketing plan, with clear goals, budget and calendar
* Define our ideal customer profiles, value proposition and positioning against competitors
* Build key messages for each type of customer and market
* Define our narrative style and tone of voice across all channels
* Own the brand guidelines and templates, so the whole company communicates in a consistent way
* Decide what we do in English and what we adapt to other languages and markets
* Follow what our competitors say and do, and share it with Sales and Product

Demand Generation & Visibility

* Own our website: landing pages, the path to "Book a demo" and continuous conversion improvement
* Lead our SEO strategy and our visibility in AI tools, so we are found and recommended when buyers search
* Own our presence on review and reputation sites such as HotelTechReport, G2 and Trustpilot, including a steady flow of new customer reviews
* Lead our LinkedIn strategy and company page
* Run email marketing and nurturing for leads who are not ready to buy yet
* Use paid channels in a focused way when they help amplify what already works
* Plan co-marketing activities with our technology and referral partners
* Organize our own webinars and online events when they make sense

Content Creation

* Create and run our blog, with a clear editorial line and a regular publishing rhythm
* Write white papers, guides and thought leadership content
* Create LinkedIn posts that get attention and move readers to act
* Produce our quarterly newsletter: product news, new features, partner and integration updates, spotlights on lesser-used modules and hotelier interviews
* Make sure every piece of content has a clear goal and a clear next step for the reader

Customer Stories & Sales Enablement

* Lead our customer success stories from start to finish: choose the hotel with Sales and Customer teams, contact the hotelier, run the interview, collect the data and write and design the story
* Collect testimonials and video quotes from happy customers
* Create and keep up to date the materials Sales uses in demos, events and meetings, such as decks, one-pagers and product sheets
* Work with Sales to understand what helps them win deals and shorten the sales cycle

Product Content & Adoption

* Review, edit and publish content for our Help Center, which is hosted in HubSpot. The Quality team owns the accuracy of the content, and you own the quality of the writing and the publishing
* Create content that explains the benefits of each module and feature, and how to set them up
* Produce product videos, including editing and AI voice-over
* Create campaigns and materials that help customers adopt modules they do not use yet, supporting upsell

Events & Trade Shows

* Be the owner of our trade shows and events from a marketing point of view, including the results
* Manage the relationship with event organizers: registration, event portal content and sponsorship options
* Own the stand design, merchandising, team outfits, catering needs and event materials
* Prepare pre-event meetings and outreach with the Sales team
* Measure the ROI of every event and recommend if we should continue or not
* Work closely with the Partnerships & Events Manager, who leads the production and logistics of each event

Data, HubSpot & Reporting

* Own the marketing setup in HubSpot: forms, workflows, email, lists, dashboards and attribution
* Define with Sales and RevOps what a qualified lead is, how leads are scored and how they are handed over
* Track and report on awareness (traffic, brand searches, LinkedIn growth, AI visibility), lead generation (inbound leads, demo requests, conversion by channel) and sales impact (content usage, customer stories, reviews, sales cycle)
* Find where visitors and leads drop off, and use data to decide what to do next
* Share clear reports with leadership: what works, what does not and what to change

Budget, Vendors & Tools

* Manage the marketing budget
* Choose and manage freelancers and agencies for specific projects, only when the impact is clear
* Own our marketing tools and AI stack, and keep looking for better ways to work

Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Quality, Product, RevOps and Partnerships & Events
* Align with regional teams across different time zones

**Required qualifications:**

* Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in SaaS or hospitality tech
* Experience building and running demand generation, from strategy to results
* Excellent writing skills in English, with the ability to create content that is clear, interesting and persuasive
* Hands-on experience with SEO and website optimization
* Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation tool
* Analytical mindset: comfortable with data, KPIs, attribution and reporting
* Daily use of AI tools for content, design, video and productivity
* Experience with LinkedIn as a B2B channel
* Basic design skills to create presentations, one-pagers and visuals with tools like Canva or Figma
* Experience with trade shows or events is a strong plus
* Fluent in English (written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus
* Organized and able to manage many projects at once

* Are ambitious and see this role as a big step in your career
* Enjoy being both the strategist and the one who gets things done
* Love telling a good story and turning it into real business results
* Make decisions with data, and are not afraid to test, learn and change direction
* Are curious about new tools and always looking for smarter ways to work with AI
* Enjoy talking to customers and learning what makes them successful
* Are proactive and take action without waiting to be asked
* Enjoy collaborating across teams, regions and time zones
* Value autonomy and ownership, and enjoy the freedom to prioritize
* Would like to grow into a leadership role and build a team in the future

**What's waiting for you?**

Impact & Growth

* Join a market leader that's growing globally
* Build our marketing function from the start, with real ownership
* Work on projects that directly affect company growth
* A clear path to lead a marketing team as the company grows

Flexibility & Balance

* Flexible working hours that respect your personal life

Team & Culture

* Collaborate with a fun, cohesive, and diverse team

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive salary aligned with your experience, responsibilities and market standards

Our Commitment
