This is a **fixed-term appointment** with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years.

  

**Location**
  
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain.

**Description**
---------------

The Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration Programmes (D/HRE) is a programme directorate within the ESA matrix structure. Through a partnership between humans and robots, D/HRE is dedicated to exploring destinations in space where humans are already living and working —– or will live and work in the future —– for the purpose of scientific research, economic development, international cooperation and public inspiration.

The Science Operations Department (SCI-S), within ESA’s Directorate of Science (D/SCI), hosts the scientists and engineers who oversee the space missions from study to the end of operations, develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, and archives and curates their data during operations and beyond. The Department provides support to D/HRE in the curation, archiving and dissemination of data from its planetary missions, such as the Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and other Mars or lunar experiments. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.

You will be assigned as Archive Scientist for ESA planetary missions under the direct responsibility of the Chief Exploration Scientist reporting functionally to the Head of the Science Archives Development and Operations Section, also known as the ESAC Science Data Centre (ESDC) in the Data Science and Archives Division within the Science Operations Department (SCI-S).

You will have further functional reporting lines within the mission(s) you support, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor.

**Duties**
----------

You will be responsible for the definition and specification of the scientific archive for the supported ESA planetary missions, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor, and for the follow-up and monitoring of its implementation and operation with the goal of maximising the scientific return of the missions. You will work in close collaboration with the planetary mission project scientists, the other mission archive scientists, the ESDC Software and Data Systems Architect and the members of the Planetary Science Archive User Group.

  

As Archive Scientist, your specific responsibilities will include:

  

* ownership of use cases and drivers for the mission archives, including:
  + interfacing with the Project Scientist, the Science Operations Centre (SOC) team, other archive science leads and other archive scientists, as well as the external stakeholders, such as the instrument teams and the mission scientific community, to provide the science use cases that drive the mission archive and determine the priorities for implementation;
  + providing scientific support and steering the development and operations of the archives for the supported ESA planetary missions, providing the ESDC development team with an archive user requirements document as a baseline for implementation;
* chairing and coordinating a mission-level Data Archive Working Group (DAWG);
* monitoring the implementation, testing and expected performance of the archive based on use cases gathered by the mission team and derived requirements; in particular, defining and performing the end user acceptance testing of the different archive versions prior to their release to the scientific community;
* with the help of the instrument operations scientists, supervising and coordinating the definition and provision of science data products and any higher-level data products from the community or instrument teams as needed, including liaising on submission schedules and content;
* liaising with any internal and external providers to ensure the completeness of all levels of data products with maximum science quality, contributing to the optimisation and refinement of the archive products when possible;
* encouraging and contributing to the science exploitation of the missions’ data products through archive usage;
* participating in archive scientist meetings and user groups and sharing ideas and proposals for the strategy and promotion of the ESA science archives;
* supporting the scientific community with archive- and data product-related matters.
  

As a scientist in the Department, you will be required to actively pursue personal scientific research, publishing articles using archival data, and to actively participate in the Department’s research activities.

**Technical competencies**
--------------------------

Experience in science data management and archiving systems

Experience working with planetary science data in a research setting, preferably including data from surface/in situ planetary missions

Experience in coordinating the scientific community and managing multiple interfaces at international level within a large multidisciplinary team.

Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions

**Behavioural competencies**
----------------------------

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking

**Education and professional experience**
-----------------------------------------

A PhD in a relevant domain is required for this post, together with one year of relevant professional experience.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

The following are assets for this position:

  

* Experience in promoting science to the wider scientific community and general public;
* Understanding of user needs in relation to complex software systems;
* Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions;
* Experience in agile and DevOps methodologies, human factor engineering (UX design) and associated technologies and their use in modern software engineering.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness**
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.

  

**Important Information and Disclaimer**
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2-A4). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.

Note that ESA is in the process of transitioning to a Matrix setup, which could lead to organisational changes affecting this position.

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.

  

**Nationality and Languages**
  
Please note that applications are only considered from nationals of one of the following States: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovakia.

Su eficacia depende sobre todo de las áreas que entregan y operan el software fuera del área del CTO.

**Fuera del área del CTO**

* Dominios de producto. Son el principal interlocutor. Aplican la metodología en sus proyectos, sean internos o externalizados, y la exigen a sus proveedores. Software Delivery les da un proceso claro y les acompaña en su adopción.
* PMO. Alinea la planificación y el seguimiento de proyectos con la metodología y con el calendario de releases.
* SRE. Define con Software Delivery los criterios de paso a producción, la observabilidad y el rollback, y aporta las métricas de fallo de cambios y tiempo de recuperación.
* Infraestructura. Provee los entornos y la infraestructura sobre los que se ejecutan los pipelines y los entornos no productivos.
* Soporte. Recibe cada release con la comunicación y el traspaso a Run adecuados, y aporta las incidencias posteriores a cada subida como indicador de calidad.
* IT4IT. Provee y opera las herramientas del ciclo de vida (requisitos, repositorios, CI/CD, gestión de servicios), conforme a los estándares definidos por Software Delivery.

**Dentro del área del CTO**

* Arquitectura y UX. Definen sus estándares; Software Delivery garantiza que intervienen en cada proyecto mediante puntos de control obligatorios.
* QA. Define la estrategia de pruebas y su automatización; Software Delivery la integra como gate en la plataforma CI/CD y en el flujo entre entornos.
* IA. Construye el framework de desarrollo agéntico; Software Delivery lo industrializa dentro del SDLC.
* Ciberseguridad. Valida los controles de seguridad de los pipelines, las APIs y los servidores MCP.

title: Content Development & Social Media Manager
description:
About Legence
  
**Legence (Nasdaq:** LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.
  
  
CONTENT DEVELOPMENT & SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
  
  

* Reports to: Vice President, Marketing, Legence
* Position Type: Direct-Hire / Full-Time
* Location: Remote; Ability to Travel up to 10%

**Position Overview:**  
Legence is seeking an experienced Content Development & Social Media Manager to lead the development and activation of compelling content across Legence and its portfolio of Business Unit brands.
  
This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for a strong writer, storyteller, and social media strategist who can translate complex technical expertise, projects, and business priorities into clear, engaging content for a range of audiences and channels.
  
This individual will help bring consistency and scale to social media across a multi-brand organization. They will partner closely with Business Unit marketing contacts, subject matter experts, executives, creative resources, communications, and the enterprise marketing team to strengthen the visibility of Legence and its companies while preserving the distinct expertise and voice of each brand.
  
Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, the built environment or another complex B2B industry is strongly preferred.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Content Strategy & Development
  

* Develop high-quality content that strengthens the visibility, reputation, and market positioning of Legence and its Business Units.
* Proactively identify compelling stories, projects, expertise, trends, and perspectives from across the enterprise and turn them into meaningful marketing content.
* Write and edit content across a variety of formats, including:
* Website and landing page copy
* Thought leadership articles
* Case studies and project profiles
* Social media content
* Executive and subject matter expert thought leadership
* Email and digital campaigns
* Industry and end-market content
* Marketing collateral
* Video scripts and supporting copy
* Press releases
* Campaign messaging
* Interview executives, technical leaders, subject matter experts and project teams to develop credible, differentiated content.
* Translate complex engineering, construction, maintenance, sustainability, energy, and technical concepts into clear, compelling stories for both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Repurpose strong content across multiple formats and channels to extend its value and reach.
* Maintain editorial quality and ensure content reflects appropriate voice, messaging and brand standards while recognizing the distinct identities of individual Business Units.
* Partner with marketing, communications, and creative teams to identify opportunities for integrated campaigns and storytelling.

Social Media Strategy & Management
  

* Help lead and execute social media strategy across Legence and supported Business Unit brands, working alongside the communications team who leads culture, recruiting, and investor related content.
* Develop and maintain editorial calendars in collaboration with Business Unit marketing contacts, communications, and enterprise stakeholders.
* Manage the development, review, approval, scheduling, and publishing of social content.
* This role is not managing direct reports or a team.
* Draft and edit social copy spanning corporate and industry content, projects, thought leadership, services, and Business Unit stories.
* Adapt content appropriately across Legence and Business Unit channels while maintaining alignment with enterprise brand and messaging standards.
* Manage day-to-day social media workflows using Sprout Social and Asana.
* Coordinate with creative resources on social graphics, photography, video, and other visual assets.
* Support employee advocacy and amplification programs designed to expand the reach of Legence and Business Unit content.
* Monitor social channels, comments, messages, mentions and relevant industry conversations, escalating issues when appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to amplify strong Business Unit stories across enterprise channels.

Campaigns & Digital Content
  

* Partner with the broader marketing team to develop integrated content campaigns supporting priority markets, services, business initiatives and growth objectives.
* Develop content that can be activated across social, web, email, thought leadership and other digital channels.
* Support campaign development and execution through HubSpot, where appropriate.
* Collaborate with marketing and Business Unit teams on targeted thought leadership and campaigns tied to services and priority market sectors.
* Apply SEO and emerging AI-search/GEO best practices to digital content to strengthen discoverability.
* Identify opportunities to extend the life and value of content by strategically repurposing it across audiences, brands and channels.

Analytics & Optimization
  

* Track and evaluate content and social performance to understand which topics, formats and channels generate the strongest engagement and results.
* Use insights from Sprout Social, web analytics, HubSpot, and other available platforms to continuously improve content strategy.
* Evaluate performance across content categories, formats and Business Units.
* Translate data and performance trends into clear recommendations for future content, campaigns and channel strategy, aligning with Legence’s Data and Analytics Manager.

Qualifications
  
Required

description:
**Company Description**

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Sia Experience is the end-to-end marketing and customer experience arm of Sia. Agile and collaborative, our Marketing AdvisoryBusiness Line is recognized for delivering high-impact, growth-focused solutions by blending marketing, CX, creative, AI, and deep industry expertise.

As strategic partners, The Marketing Advisory team empowers clients across technology, luxury, consumer goods, finance, energy, and more to scale operational excellence and drive brand-led growth through AI- and data-driven strategies. Our teams lead full-funnel marketing transformations—from strategy and go-to-market execution to experience design, performance measurement, and sustainable impact.

It’s an exciting time to join us. SiaX has long been the agency behind some of the world’s biggest brands—now we’re expanding, becoming one of the most recognizable names for companies that demand bold, business-driving creative. We’re shaping SiaX into the go-to agency of the future. This is your chance to be part of that growth, working alongside top-tier creatives, consultants and agency leaders to continuously evolve what a modern, full-service agency can be. Opportunities like this don’t come around often—if you want in on the next level, this is it.

 **Job Description**

Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project-based work.

**Sia Title:** Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)

**Project Title:** Senior Lifecycle & CRM Strategy Leader

**Project Length:** This is a contract role that could span 6 months with the possibility of extension

**Project Hours:** 40 hours per week

**Location:** Remote

**Rate:** $90-110/hr The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.

**About the role**

We’re seeking a senior lifecycle and CRM leader to build a coordinated customer-growth capability for a digital-presence services business serving entrepreneurs, small businesses, freelancers, and customers building and managing an online presence. The portfolio spans domain registration, website creation, web hosting, professional email, security, and digital marketing solutions.

The business is evolving from product- and campaign-led communications toward a more integrated lifecycle model. You will assess the current state, define the highest-value customer journeys, and establish a practical roadmap connecting customer and account data, setup and service signals, marketing technology, content, measurement, and cross-functional execution.

The work should help customers move from purchasing a domain or digital service to successfully establishing, activating, managing, protecting, and growing their online presence. It should strengthen service activation, time to value, complementary-service adoption, renewal readiness, retention, expansion, and win-back. You will serve as a senior advisor while remaining hands-on in shaping the first wave of journeys, tests, and operating practices.

**What You’ll Do**

* Assess the end-to-end digital-presence lifecycle. Map the experience from domain search and purchase through account setup, website creation and launch, hosting and professional email activation, security adoption, ongoing management, renewal, cancellation or lapse, win-back, and expansion into relevant adjacent services.
* Build the lifecycle strategy and roadmap. Define lifecycle stages, customer and business outcomes, journey priorities, and a sequenced plan balancing immediate improvements with longer-term data, technology, content, and operating-model needs.
* Design high-value customer journeys. Develop coordinated programs for onboarding, service activation, website launch, customer education, renewal preparation, lapse prevention, retention, service recovery, win-back, and expansion into complementary digital-presence services.
* Advance segmentation and trigger strategy. Define actionable audiences and triggers using customer profile, domain and service purchases, setup milestones, website launch status, account activity, billing and renewal status, support interactions, engagement, and service-portfolio signals.
* Connect CRM, service, and channel data. Determine the data, identity, consent, automation, and integration capabilities required to coordinate experiences across email, web, account experiences, service interactions, and other available channels.
* Improve personalization and next-best-action decisions. Deliver relevant setup guidance, website-launch support, education, security and renewal reminders, complementary-service recommendations, and re-engagement based on where customers are in building and managing their online presence.
* Establish experimentation and measurement. Define baselines, test plans, controls, and reporting for setup completion, service activation, website launch, time to value, multi-service relationships, engagement, renewal, lapse prevention, retention, win-back, customer value, and incremental commercial impact.
* Create the lifecycle operating model. Clarify decision rights, ownership, intake, prioritization, approvals, production, reporting, and optimization across marketing, product, ecommerce, customer care, data, analytics, creative, and technology.
* Move the first wave into delivery. Translate recommendations into journey maps, briefs, audience and trigger definitions, content requirements, test designs, measurement plans, and a prioritized delivery backlog.
* Build sustainable internal capability. Create reusable frameworks, governance, documentation, and working rhythms that enable internal teams to continuously improve lifecycle programs.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clear lifecycle and CRM maturity assessment covering journeys, data, segmentation, triggers, channels, technology, content, measurement, and team capability.
* A prioritized roadmap tied to customers establishing, activating, managing, protecting, and growing their online presence, with measurable outcomes across time to value, renewal, retention, expansion, and win-back.
* A defined first wave of journeys with owners, requirements, dependencies, tests, and measurement.
* A more connected experience for customers holding one or multiple services across domains, websites, hosting, professional email, security, digital marketing, billing, renewals, and support.
* Clear governance and operating rhythms across the functions supporting the customer experience.
* Internal teams equipped to sustain and improve the lifecycle capability.

 **Qualifications**

* Approximately 15+ years across lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, customer engagement, marketing automation, customer journey, or growth CRM.
* Senior Director or VP-level experience advising executives and influencing cross-functional decisions.
* Experience building a lifecycle capability from a low-maturity starting point, not only optimizing an established program.
* Deep experience with recurring-revenue digital services, especially domain registration, web hosting, website building, professional email, online security, digital marketing, ecommerce enablement, or adjacent small-business services.
* Ability to connect customer strategy with data, identity, consent, marketing technology, service signals, support interactions, content, execution, and measurement.
* Experience designing journeys from purchase through setup, activation, launch, ongoing value realization, renewal, expansion, retention, service recovery, lapse prevention, and win-back.
* Fluency in segmentation, event-based triggers, journey orchestration, personalization, experimentation, and incremental measurement.
* Experience managing lifecycle complexity across customers who may own a single service or a portfolio of interconnected digital-presence services.
* Ability to balance executive counsel with hands-on development of journey maps, briefs, audience definitions, test plans, roadmaps, and operating processes.
* Availability for a fully remote, full-time contract engagement aligned to Pacific Time working hours.

 **Additional Information**

**Work Authorization**

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

description:
Fabula is a fast-growing D2C coffee brand in the United States. Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Fabula to the next level.

**This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.**
**Success means:**

* Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics
* Improving ROAS and reducing CPA
* Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity
* Finding new winning angles and audiences
* Improving conversion rates across the funnel
* Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system

**not**

title: Director of Product Design
description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

**What success looks like:**

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

* Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.
* Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.
* Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.
* Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.
* Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.
* Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.
* Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.
* Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.
* Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.
* Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.
* See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.
* Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.
* A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.
* You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.
* You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.
* You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.
* You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.
* Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.
* You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.
* You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.
* You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

* Oversee scalable design systems, component libraries, pattern governance, and documentation in Figma, working with engineering partners to improve quality and delivery efficiency.
* Build accessibility into the work from the start, applying WCAG 2.2 AA principles and inclusive design practices rather than treating compliance as a final review step.

**Client and Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as a trusted senior design partner to clients, clearly articulating experience strategy, design rationale, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive and working teams.
* Lead high-stakes presentations, workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions, creating alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
* Partner with project and account leadership on scope, staffing, schedules, assumptions, and change management; surface delivery risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Represent Product Design in new-business opportunities, estimates, proposals, capability presentations, and pitch work.

* Manage, coach, and develop product designers across levels through clear expectations, actionable feedback, growth plans, and regular career conversations.
* Create an environment where designers can do their best work, with strong critique, psychological safety, accountability, and thoughtful delegation.
* Partner with Experience leadership on hiring, staffing, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
* Improve the Product Design practice through reusable methods, templates, standards, training, and responsible adoption of emerging tools, including AI-enabled workflows.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration across Product Design, UX, Creative, Technology, and Strategy, reducing silos and improving continuity from concept through launch.

#### **What Success Looks Like**

* Clients see Product Design as a strategic partner, not only a production capability.
* Teams have clear experience direction, decision criteria, and an appropriate level of design leadership from discovery through delivery.
* Creates a more consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience across the portfolio.
* Designers receive strong coaching, understand what is expected of them, and demonstrate measurable growth.
* The practice becomes more scalable through better systems, methods, staffing decisions, and cross-functional ways of working.
* Experience recommendations connect to defined user, client, and business outcomes.

#### **What You Should Have**

* 10+ years of experience in product design, experience design, interaction design, or a related discipline, including 3+ years managing and developing designers.
* A portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-channel digital products or platforms, from strategy and concept through detailed design and launch.
* Experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of client engagements in an agency, consultancy, product organization, or similarly complex environment.
* Deep fluency in human-centered design, interaction design, visual systems, prototyping, responsive design, information architecture, and design systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Figma and modern collaborative design workflows; familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and prototyping or motion tools is helpful.
* Practical knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, and the ability to guide teams in designing inclusive experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, product, research, content, analytics, strategy, creative, and account teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience defining design outcomes and using research, usability testing, analytics, and performance data to improve experiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, making informed trade-offs, and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on guidance when the work requires it.

#### **This Position Is a Strong Fit If**

* You can move between the 30,000-foot view and the detail that determines whether an experience actually works.
* You are direct, low-ego, generous with feedback, and able to challenge the work while supporting the people doing it.
* You bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate needs, and help teams make better decisions faster.
* You care about craft, but judge success by the quality, usefulness, accessibility, and impact of the experience.
* Our Company values – *Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always* and *Accountability with an “I”* – really speak to you.
* You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
* You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience with privacy, consent, regulated content, and design considerations for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.

title: Director, Brand & Creative Marketing
description:
As a Director of Brand & Creative Marketing, will own the evolution of MongoDB's global brand identity and creative expression. MongoDB isn't just about logos or design systems—it's about driving real business outcomes, translating our complex technical offerings into stories and experiences, and fostering pride and loyalty among all audiences. This is your chance to shape the creative future of one of the fastest-growing enterprise companies in the world.

You will lead and influence all aspects of MongoDB's brand visual expression. You are an articulate champion for design, passionate about quality and craft, and an experienced leader of diverse teams who can elevate ambitious work while delivering outstanding business results. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Marketing, you will work with peer leaders in Marketing and Product to transform the MongoDB brand to drive mindshare and market share with developer and executive audiences.

You are responsible for leading a team of creative professionals and collaborating with marketing, product, and sales to develop marketing plans, analyze results, and identify opportunities. You are also responsible for meeting budget requirements by forecasting and managing expectations.

Strategic Impact & Vision

* Identify and resolve strategic challenges by innovating bold, creative solutions that drive transformation and brand loyalty

* Lead narrative-driven storytelling across a variety of mediums (digital, video, events, product experiences, swag, etc.). Make technical complexity feel engaging, empowering, and relatable
* Stay ahead of emerging creative technologies, including AI, generative design, motion, and interactive storytelling. Leverage these tools not just for efficiency, but to unlock bold, new creative possibilities

Team Leadership & Collaboration

* Champion a culture of creativity and collaboration, driving strong concept development, attention to craft, and team cohesion

* Experiment boldly across digital, live events, swag, and interactive environments to create unforgettable experiences that make "using MongoDB" synonymous with belonging to something bigger

This includes centralizing brand information, guidelines, collaboration tools, and digital asset management to ensure consistent brand communication
* Present design concepts and strategies to senior leadership, influencing decisions and direction. Through regular reviews and meetings, ensure clarity and consistent workflow
* Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project buy-in and execution

* Maintain and model a high bar for quality and taste
* Prioritize work and resources across engagements based on short- and long-term needs and develop schedules by collaborating with designers, copywriters, and production artists
* Conduct brainstorming sessions with the creative team, maintaining strategic thinking to develop innovative and actionable initiatives in a fiscally responsible manner
* Review and approve art and copy developed by the team, ensuring that deliverables effectively address marketing goals and challenges
* Lead creative and design direction for brand initiatives, ensuring consistency and excellence
* Inspire, mentor, and lead a diverse team of design practitioners, fostering a culture of excellence, creativity, and collaboration
* Direct multiple projects, stakeholders, and budgets within deadlines. Manage budgets efficiently, maximizing ROI

### **Required skills and qualifications**

* Experience crafting and operationalizing branding and design systems for B2B, technology/SaaS brands across print, digital, video, etc. Experience working at or with databases, data analytics, data science, or similar products is a plus

* Strong creative vision with an eye on business objectives

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Director of Design Execution
description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Director of Design Execution**
------------------------------------------

The Director of Design Execution provides enterprise leadership for the practical execution, technical coordination, and field validation of data center designs across Switch's project portfolio. This role leads the team responsible for translating design intent into solutions that are safe, constructible, commissionable, operable, maintainable, and repeatable.

You will lead Design Execution from post-design handoff through construction, commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness while providing technical support throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. You will establish engineering governance, execution standards, decision and escalation processes, and feedback mechanisms that improve reliability and consistency across regions.

This role leads a team of technical subject matter experts and manages supporting third-party consultants and contractors. You will also partner closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to improve project delivery and turn field experience into standards and lessons learned for future projects.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and develop the Design Execution team, including technical subject matter experts and supporting third-party consultants and contractors.
* Set team priorities, allocate resources, establish performance expectations, and provide coaching and development.
* Lead Design Execution activities across the project lifecycle, including design handoff, construction, commissioning, turnover, operations support, infrastructure improvements, and end-of-life planning.
* Establish and maintain the engineering governance framework for post-IFC execution, including handoff requirements, engineering decision management, escalation pathways, design-change oversight, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Translate design intent into practical field execution requirements that support constructability, commissioning, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Oversee resolution of construction and field engineering issues, including complex procedure reviews, critical equipment concerns, and technical event support.
* Oversee engineering solutions for upgrades and retrofits that increase capacity, availability, efficiency, reliability, or operational capability across existing data centers.
* Provide technical leadership for electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including transformers, generators, UPS systems, power distribution, HVAC and cooling systems, controls, and related critical infrastructure.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, specifications, submittals, and other engineering documentation.
* Partner with Design Engineering to translate field experience, operational feedback, commissioning results, and lessons learned into improved standards and future designs.
* Coordinate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, and other stakeholders to maintain consistent technical and execution standards across projects.
* Manage engineering consultants, vendors, contractors, and other external technical resources supporting Design Execution.
* Establish processes, procedures, and tools that enable consistent execution and support customer and project requirements across data center campuses.
* Establish and monitor Design Execution performance metrics and provide project, risk, and program updates to senior leadership.
* Lead assigned engineering projects and programs and ensure delivery against schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and implementation activities with facility leadership to minimize operational disruption.
* Ensure Design Execution activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, Switch requirements, and safety standards, including NFPA 70E requirements where applicable.
* Support Operations during turnover, customer-impacting events, near misses, and other complex technical situations.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring field challenges, and opportunities to improve execution, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
* Build strong working relationships across Operations, Finance, Legal, Construction, Commissioning, Design Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain an active field presence to understand conditions firsthand and validate that solutions can be executed as intended.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You lead technical teams with clear expectations, accountability, coaching, and consistent follow-through.

title: Senior Director, Product Creative Direction
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**Team and Role**

This role is part of our Product Design team, which turns a deep understanding of our users and customers into product experiences they love. Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with Engineering and Product Management from the outset.

We're looking for a Senior Director of Product Creative Direction to define and evolve the visual expression of our product portfolio. This leader will set a distinctive product visual direction, translate it into a scalable system, and help teams make complex enterprise software feel clear, coherent, modern, and unmistakably ServiceNow.

This is a product-focused creative leadership role. You will work as part of cross-functional software development teams and partner across Platform and the business units to connect creative vision with customer needs, product strategy, and technical realities. Product teams retain ownership of their product strategy, design, roadmap, quality, and delivery; this role provides shared visual direction, systems, critique, and enablement.

You will also advance the responsible use of AI in creative work and make accessibility intrinsic to the product visual language.

**What you get to do in this role**

* Define and champion a differentiated visual direction for the product portfolio, grounded in our brand, customer needs, product strategy, and the evolving relationship between people and AI.
* Establish a clear point of view across typography, color, composition, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, density, and other visual foundations.
* Create future-state concepts, reference experiences, and exemplars that make the visual direction tangible.
* Work with Design Systems, Product Design, Content Design, Accessibility, Localization, and Research to translate the visual language into scalable foundations, components, patterns, and guidance.
* Partner with Design Systems, Product Management and Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle so the creative direction can be applied effectively in shipped products.
* Define where consistency is essential, where variation creates value, and how teams can extend the system without creating a centralized bottleneck.
* Lead the strategy for AI-enabled creative exploration, prototyping, asset creation, system evolution, and evaluation, focusing on meaningful gains in range, speed, consistency, and quality.
* Move promising AI approaches from experimentation to repeatable practice through pilots, playbooks, training, exemplars, responsible-use standards, and measurable adoption goals.
* Provide creative direction and hands-on critique for priority, cross-product initiatives while reinforcing product-team ownership.
* Partner with Brand and Marketing so the company expression and product experience tell a coherent story while remaining useful and native to interactive software.
* Make accessibility intrinsic to the creative vision and visual foundations, partnering with Accessibility and Engineering to meet or exceed applicable standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA.
* Lead, develop, and attract exceptional visual, motion, and multidisciplinary design talent.
* Build the culture, enablement, and shared critique practices that help product designers and distributed visual designers understand, apply, and continually raise the visual craft bar.
* Build a network of creative leaders and contributors across the business units who can extend the direction while maintaining coherence.

 **Qualifications**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in product design, visual design, experience design, creative direction, or a related field, including significant leadership experience shipping complex digital products.
* A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and creative leadership across shipped product experiences, not only brand campaigns or marketing communications.
* Experience defining or materially evolving a visual language across a complex, multi-product software portfolio.
* Deep understanding of design systems, including visual foundations, design tokens, components, patterns, governance, contribution models, and the relationship between design and code.
* Demonstrated experience adopting AI-enabled creative tools and workflows and moving teams from isolated experimentation to sustained, responsible use at scale.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and align multiple organizations without relying solely on reporting authority.
* Expert command of typography, color, composition, interaction, motion, and information hierarchy, with the judgment to apply them to dense and complex product workflows.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to connect an inspiring creative idea to the practices and adoption mechanisms required to make it real at scale.
* Demonstrated commitment to accessible and inclusive design, with working knowledge of WCAG and platform accessibility considerations.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, facilitation, and critique skills, including the ability to make a direction compelling to executives and actionable for delivery teams.
* Experience leading leaders and building high-performing, inclusive creative teams.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience participating in the complete product development lifecycle of web and/or software applications.
* Experience working as a member of cross-functional Product Management, Engineering, and Design teams.
* Experience leading creative teams and partnering across a complex organization.

title: Director of Brand and Creative
description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof's brand has to signal two things at once: the rigor of a WebTrust-audited certificate authority that banks can rely on, and the simplicity of an identity people can verify once and reuse anywhere. As Proof expands from the online notarization category we created into portable digital identity and agentic authorization, our brand needs to grow with us.

As Director of Brand and Creative, you'll own Proof's brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, and creative output across every touchpoint, including proof.com, campaigns, events, sales materials, and executive presence. Day to day, you'll set creative direction, lead design production, and build a brand that earns trust from regulated institutions and stands out in identity and fintech.

### **What you’ll do as the Director of Brand and Creative at Proof:**

* Brand strategy and architecture: Define and steward Proof's brand platform (purpose, personality, voice, and the promise of trust in high-consequence transactions), and develop brand architecture for the platform, VDC, notarization, and agentic authorization with the Director of Product Marketing. Lead brand evolution or refresh work as needed.
* Visual and verbal identity: Own the brand system and guidelines, including logo, color, typography, iconography, illustration, photography, motion, and data visualization. Partner with the Head of Demand Content and Director of Communications on tone-of-voice guidelines.
* Brand hub and templates: Build a self-serve brand hub and template library so Sales,  
  Marketing, and the wider company stay on brand.
* Campaign and launch creative: Lead creative concepting and execution for  
  campaigns, product launches, and brand moments with Revenue Marketing and Product Marketing.
* Design across touchpoints: Oversee design for proof.com, digital advertising, sales collateral, presentations, video, social, and event environments, including booth and experiential design with the Event Marketing Manager.
* Creative operations: Run intake, prioritization, and review and approval workflows, and manage creative budgets, agencies, and freelancers.
* Brand health and governance: Establish brand health metrics and research  
  (awareness, consideration, perception among target buyers), govern consistency across marketing, sales, partners, and co-marketing, and work with Product Design so the product and marketing brand feel like one company.

### **What we're looking for:**

* 10+ years in brand and creative, including 4+ years leading brand or creative teams at a B2B technology, fintech, or security company, or senior agency experience on comparable brands.
* A portfolio showing brand systems and campaigns that made complex or trust-centric products clear and distinctive.
* Experience leading a brand refresh or new brand architecture during a company's category expansion.
* Strong creative direction across design, copy, video, and motion, and the ability to get hands-on when needed.
* Ability to align executives on creative decisions and explain the business rationale behind brand choices.

### **You'll really stand out if you have:**

* Experience building brands for financial services, payments, or identity companies.
* Experience with AI-assisted creative workflows and modern tooling (Figma, Adobe CC, Webflow).
* Experience spanning both B2B enterprise and consumer-facing touchpoints.

### **Position Logistics:**

**Travel:** This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

### **Our Proof Pillars:**

* **Pave the Way:** When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
* **Own It:** We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
* **Act with Integrity:** We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
* **Play to Win:** We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

### **Here are some of our great benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
* 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date
* Unlimited Sick and Vacation time
* 14 paid company holidays
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment
* Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation
* Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit
* Monthly work from home stipend
* Professional development credit
* Monthly reimbursement for Wellness
* And more!

$180,000 - $250,000 a year

This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, discretionary bonus typically paid annually, the benefits listed above, and equity.

This position will be posted and accepting applications through October 30, 2026.

Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. title: Director of Brand & Creative Marketing
description:
**Director of Brand & Creative Marketing**
==========================================

Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to the Co-CEOs | Remote (U.S.) | Director: $150k-210k
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

***Please note: Must submit a portfolio to be considered for this role.***

**About the Role**
------------------

Seeking is looking for a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on **Director / Sr. Director of Brand & Creative Marketing** to lead the brand side of our marketing organization.

This is not a traditional management role and it is not a position for someone who wants to sit above the work.

We are looking for an operator.

This person will own Seeking's brand marketing strategy and lead an approximately 13-person organization spanning PR, creative, copy, social, influencer marketing, and broader brand initiatives and activations. They will be responsible for turning company goals into marketing strategy, turning strategy into executable plans, ensuring the right people are accountable for the right work, and ultimately determining whether that work is moving the business.

The role works closely with Seeking's Co-CEOs and alongside our Director of Growth and Lifecycle Marketing. Our Digital Marketing team owns areas such as paid acquisition, lifecycle/CRM, conversion optimization, and digital growth. This role owns the brand side of marketing while partnering closely with Growth to ensure both functions operate as one marketing organization and share accountability for company performance.

Seeking moves quickly. Our team is lean, scrappy, ambitious, and highly adaptable. The right person is comfortable making decisions, changing direction when the data requires it, getting into the details, and personally helping solve problems when necessary.

We do not need another layer of management. We need someone capable of building and leading a high-performing marketing organization.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **Marketing strategy, performance, and budget**

* Own Seeking's brand marketing strategy, positioning, messaging, audience strategy, and overall brand direction.
* Translate company objectives into quarterly and annual marketing priorities, initiatives, OKRs, budgets, and measurable business outcomes.
* Develop the marketing strategy in close partnership with the Co-CEOs, progressively assuming greater ownership as alignment and trust are established.
* Understand Seeking's distinct audiences and develop strategies capable of effectively reaching both sides of the marketplace.
* Identify untapped audiences, market opportunities, positioning gaps, competitive opportunities, and new ways to grow the business.
* Own consumer research, competitive intelligence, campaign learnings, and brand insights.
* Determine what Seeking should do more of, less of, stop doing, or approach differently based on performance and business priorities.

### **Integrated Campaign Leadership**

* Originate and lead major brand campaigns from initial insight through strategy, concept, execution, launch, measurement, and post-campaign analysis.
* Develop bold, culturally relevant ideas capable of generating conversation, press, signups, and revenue.
* Define the objective, audience, strategic insight, messaging, channels, success metrics, budget, responsibilities, and execution plan for major initiatives.
* Work closely with Creative, Production, PR, Social, Influencer, Digital Marketing, Product, Legal, and external partners to bring campaigns to market.
* Personally contribute ideas rather than relying exclusively on the team for campaign concepts.
* Evaluate concepts, scripts, copy, messaging, creative direction, activations, partnerships, and channel plans with strong creative and commercial judgment.
* Lead campaign production, including talent, agencies, production partners, shoots, post-production, rollout, media requirements, legal considerations, and timelines.

### **Performance & Business Accountability**

* Own the performance of the brand marketing organization and ensure marketing activity ultimately contributes to business growth.
* Monitor company and marketing performance closely, including joins, revenue, CAC, ROAS, conversion, brand search, campaign performance, social growth, influencer performance, earned media, and other relevant KPIs.
* Diagnose why initiatives are or are not working and make changes quickly.
* Reallocate budget, resources, priorities, or strategy when performance does not justify the current approach.
* Maximize ROI across productions and activations by identifying opportunities to create additional revenue-driving content within existing budgets, helping recover costs and improve the overall return on each investment.
* Establish meaningful measurement frameworks for brand initiatives that connect marketing activity to commercial outcomes, including brand health.
* Partner closely with the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing to understand acquisition and funnel performance and ensure brand and performance marketing strengthen one another.
* Lead campaign and quarterly retrospectives and turn learnings into concrete changes.

### **PR & Cultural Relevance**

* Set the overarching PR narrative and determine what Seeking should be known for culturally.
* Lead and challenge the PR organization on strategy, angles, pitches, media opportunities, reactive opportunities, partnerships, spokesperson positioning, and execution.
* Help develop provocative, differentiated stories that can break through crowded cultural conversations while protecting the business and brand.
* Be comfortable operating around controversial subjects and challenging cultural conversations without becoming unnecessarily risk-averse.
* Understand what makes a story interesting to media rather than simply what the company wants to communicate.
* Be capable of rewriting or strengthening an angle, headline, pitch, talking point, or narrative when senior intervention is required.
* Build and develop a strong internal PR function rather than relying exclusively on agencies to provide strategic thinking.
* Own reputation and crisis communications, partnering with the Co-CEOs and Legal to protect the brand.

### **Team Leadership & Organizational Performance**

* Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable an approximately 13-person brand marketing organization.
* Manage managers and senior individual contributors across Creative, Production, PR, Social, Influencer, Copy, Brand Marketing, and related functions.
* Establish clear ownership, expectations, goals, accountability, and decision-making authority across the department.
* Evaluate talent continuously and identify where employees need coaching, clearer expectations, additional resources, changed responsibilities, or stronger performance management.
* Recognize high-potential employees and create opportunities for them to grow.
* Make difficult personnel recommendations when performance does not meet the needs of the business.
* Identify organizational gaps and recommend changes to team structure, roles, hiring plans, agencies, contractors, or external resources.
* Participate meaningfully in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, performance management, and termination decisions.
* Build a culture that combines empathy and development with extremely high standards for performance.

### **Marketing Operations & Planning**

* Own the integrated marketing calendar in partnership with the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing.
* Set department priorities and determine what gets worked on, delayed, re-scoped, or stopped.
* Turn large initiatives into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and success metrics.
* Build and continuously improve the operating processes required for a sophisticated marketing organization.
* Establish clear processes for briefs, campaign development, research, creative concepting, moodboards, reviews, approvals, production, PR planning, launch readiness, asset delivery, reporting, and postmortems.
* Ensure teams are brought into initiatives at the right stage rather than operating reactively.
* Remove bottlenecks before they reach the executive team.
* Identify unclear ownership and correct it.
* Ensure initiatives move forward without requiring the Co-CEOs to manage day-to-day execution.

### **Budget & Commercial Management**

* Own and manage a significant seven-figure brand marketing budget.
* Build annual and quarterly budgets and allocate resources against the highest-value opportunities.
* Evaluate spend based on strategic importance and expected business return.
* Maintain visibility into commitments, actual spend, forecasts, and ROI.
* Oversee agencies, production partners, talent, influencers, vendors, sponsorships, and other external relationships.
* Lead or oversee high-stakes negotiations and ensure the team is negotiating effectively.
* Challenge unnecessary spend and identify opportunities to achieve better outcomes with existing resources.

**How This Role Works With Other Marketing Leaders**
----------------------------------------------------

### **Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing**

The Director / Sr. Director of Brand & Creative Marketing and Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing will operate as peer leaders.

This role owns brand strategy, integrated brand campaigns, PR, Creative, Copy, Social, Influencer, brand activations, consumer insights, and the brand marketing budget.

The two leaders jointly plan around company goals, audience strategy, campaign performance, acquisition, landing-page effectiveness, creative performance, the marketing calendar, and overall business growth.

  

**Leadership vs. Delegation**
-----------------------------

The Director creates the environment in which the marketing team can perform at a higher level by setting the strategy, establishing priorities, structuring the work, challenging the thinking, coaching the team, reviewing performance, removing gaps, and holding the organization accountable for results.

At the same time, this is a hands-on leadership role.

When a major campaign needs a stronger concept, a pitch needs to be rewritten, messaging is not working, a brief is unclear, a negotiation is stuck, or an important initiative needs senior attention, this person is expected to get involved and help solve it.

Strong leaders here do not say, "That's not my job."

They also do not take over their employees' jobs.

They know when to coach, when to challenge, when to make the decision, and when to roll up their sleeves.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, with exceptional candidates considered based on demonstrated scope and trajectory rather than years alone.
* 4+ years of meaningful people-management experience, including experience managing managers or senior functional leaders.
* Demonstrated experience across both brand marketing and PR/communications.
* Strong experience developing and executing integrated consumer marketing campaigns.
* Experience in a startup, high-growth environment, agency environment, or similarly fast-moving business, with the ability to operate with a high sense of urgency and keep pace with rapid execution, shifting priorities, and tight deadlines.
* Experience owning or meaningfully managing substantial marketing budgets.
* Experience working with agencies, production companies, creators, talent, vendors, and external partners.
* Working knowledge of campaign production from concept through delivery and distribution.
* Exceptional copy judgment and the ability to provide meaningful feedback across advertising, PR, social, influencer scripts, campaign messaging, and brand communications.
* Strong negotiator with sound commercial judgment.
* Experience creating structure, processes, and accountability inside growing or evolving teams.
* Comfortable making difficult decisions with incomplete information.
* Able to operate effectively with founders and senior executives who are highly engaged in the brand.
* Confident enough to challenge an executive recommendation when the data, customer insight, or strategy supports a different direction.

Marketplace or two-sided consumer platform experience is a plus.

Experience with culturally provocative, unconventional, entertainment, lifestyle, dating, or otherwise conversation-driving brands is highly valued.

Through parent support, education, community engagement, and advocacy, Love Your School works to advance and protect education freedom while helping families navigate school choice programs and policies.

As Love Your School expands into additional states, State Chapter Leads will play an important role in bringing our mission to families in their home state.

The State Chapter Lead serves as the primary leader and representative of Love Your School within their state. This individual will launch and grow a state chapter focused on supporting families, building strong community relationships, and advancing and protecting school choice policies.

The State Chapter Lead will identify and bring together 2–3 additional individuals who share Love Your School’s mission and can serve alongside them as the chapter’s initial Executive Team.

Provide direct parent support by helping families understand and navigate education options, including ESAs, open enrollment, charter schools, homeschooling, scholarship programs, and special education resources.

Run a state-specific Love Your School podcast, including identifying relevant topics and guests and hosting conversations that educate and engage families.

Manage and grow the state’s Love Your School Facebook group, sharing resources and updates, answering parent questions, and building an engaged community of families.

Participate in community events, including parent gatherings, school events, conferences, tabling opportunities, webinars, and other outreach activities.

Build strong, professional relationships with parents, schools, community organizations, education leaders, and other partners throughout the state.

Recruit and lead 2–3 additional individuals to serve as the chapter’s Executive Team and help carry out chapter activities and goals.

description:
